items.title: iPhone 16, 17 y 18 Pro: diferencias en calidad, precio y características
items.author: Redacción Bloomberg Línea
items.summary: El iPhone 18 Pro incorpora cambios en cámara, procesador y batería frente a sus antecesores, pero un iPhone 17 Pro usado puede ofrecer características similares por un precio menor.
items.body: Un análisis publicado por Swappa, un marketplace especializado en dispositivos usados, compara el iPhone 18 Pro con generaciones anteriores y señala que la diferencia en características puede ser menor que la brecha de precio, especialmente frente a un iPhone 17 Pro usado. VER MÁS: ¿Cuánto costará el nuevo iPhone? Esto anticipan JPMorgan, Bank of America y Citi para el Apple Event El iPhone 16 incorpora el chip A18, una pantalla de 6,1 pulgadas con frecuencia de actualización de 60 Hz y una cámara principal de 48 megapíxeles, pero no cuenta con teleobjetivo. El iPhone 17 incorpora el chip A19, una pantalla de 6,3 pulgadas con ProMotion de 120 Hz y función de pantalla siempre activa. También suma una cámara ultra gran angular de 48 megapíxeles, frente a los 12 megapíxeles del iPhone 16. El iPhone 17 Pro añade el chip A19 Pro y un sistema de cámaras Pro con teleobjetivo de 48 megapíxeles, además de zoom óptico de 4x y 8x. El iPhone 18 Pro mantiene una pantalla de 6,3 pulgadas con 120 Hz y un sistema de tres cámaras de 48 megapíxeles, pero incorpora una cámara principal con apertura variable y el chip A20 Pro de 2 nanómetros. Swappa también señala una mayor autonomía, de hasta 36 horas de reproducción de video, frente a 33 horas en el 17 Pro. El iPhone 18 Pro parte de US$1.199, mientras que el iPhone 17 tiene un precio inicial de US$899 y el iPhone 16 de US$799 en la línea nueva de Apple, según los precios relevados por Swappa. La comparación cambia al observar el mercado de usados. El análisis ubica al iPhone 16 en torno a los US$500, al iPhone 17 cerca de los US$650, al iPhone 16 Pro alrededor de US$650 y al iPhone 17 Pro cerca de US$850. Swappa aclara que estos son valores orientativos y que pueden variar según el almacenamiento, el estado del equipo y la oferta disponible. Para presupuestos de entre US$600 y US$800, Swappa ubica al iPhone 16 Pro y al iPhone 17 entre las alternativas disponibles en el mercado de segunda mano. En ese rango, el comprador puede acceder a características como una pantalla de 120 Hz o un sistema de cámaras Pro por menos que el precio de un modelo nuevo. Entre US$800 y US$1.000 aparece el iPhone 17 Pro usado, mientras que por encima de US$1.000 el análisis señala al iPhone 17 Pro Max usado como una alternativa cercana al 18 Pro en características. Así, los modelos usados permiten acceder a buena parte de las funciones de generaciones recientes con un desembolso menor. La diferencia más clara está en la pantalla y las cámaras. El iPhone 16 tiene una frecuencia de actualización de 60 Hz, mientras que el iPhone 17 incorpora ProMotion de 120 Hz y función de pantalla siempre activa. El iPhone 17 también lleva una cámara ultra gran angular de 48 megapíxeles, frente a los 12 megapíxeles del iPhone 16. Swappa señala que esta diferencia puede ser relevante para quienes utilizan habitualmente ese tipo de cámara, pero menos para quienes toman principalmente fotografías convencionales. Según Swappa, el iPhone 18 Pro puede resultar especialmente atractivo para quienes buscan sus nuevas funciones, como la apertura variable de la cámara, una mayor autonomía o un equipo que planean conservar durante varios años. Para quienes ya tienen un iPhone 17 Pro, las diferencias son más acotadas. Ambos comparten una pantalla de 6,3 pulgadas y un sistema de tres cámaras de 48 megapíxeles, mientras que el 18 Pro incorpora principalmente el nuevo chip, la apertura variable y una mayor duración de batería. En términos de autonomía, el iPhone 18 Pro alcanza hasta 36 horas de reproducción de video, frente a las 33 horas del 17 Pro, según los datos recopilados por Swappa. Swappa señala que los iPhone usados suelen venderse entre 30% y 60% por debajo del precio de los modelos nuevos, aunque el descuento depende del modelo, el almacenamiento, el estado del equipo y la oferta disponible. El análisis también plantea que el precio debe evaluarse en función del tiempo previsto de uso. Un iPhone 18 Pro nuevo parte con una ventana completa de soporte, mientras que un iPhone 16 o 17 comprado usado ya lleva uno o dos años desde su lanzamiento. VER MÁS: Precio del iPhone Duo arranca en US$2.000: cuánto costaría traer el primer plegable por courier a Argentina La comparación, por lo tanto, no se limita a las especificaciones. El precio, las funciones que realmente utiliza el comprador y los años durante los que espera conservar el equipo son factores que modifican la relación entre costo y características.
items.raw_description: El iPhone 18 Pro incorpora cambios en cámara, procesador y batería frente a sus antecesores, pero un iPhone 17 Pro usado puede ofrecer características similares por un precio menor.

items.title: Hacked FBI data has sensitive information about employees’ intelligence roles
items.author: Raphael Satter, A.J. Vicens
items.creator: Raphael Satter, A.J. Vicens
items.summary: FBI data allegedly stolen by the hacking group ShinyHunters carries granular detail about scores of bureau officials’ job assignments, including sensitive work against Chinese spies, Russian intelligence, drug cartels, and more, Reuters has found.
items.body:
FBI data [USN:L6N45E0VU TEXT:"allegedly stolen"] by the hacking group ShinyHunters carries granular detail about scores of bureau officials’ job assignments, including sensitive work against Chinese spies, Russian intelligence, drug cartels, and more, Reuters has found.
The 5,000-line spreadsheet – said by the hackers to represent only a small piece of their claimed two- to three-terabyte trove – includes names, addresses, telephone numbers, dates of birth, social security numbers, and emergency contact details for what they claimed were thousands of FBI employees. It also includes details of assignments to specific field offices and, in some cases, to units engaged in high-stakes intelligence, security, or counterespionage work.
In a statement, the FBI said it was aware of "a cyber-criminal enterprise group claiming a compromise of the FBIJobs.gov portal and alleged impact to FBI employee personally identifiable information." The bureau said the cause of the breach was still undetermined, but that it was "actively and aggressively investigating the matter."
The hackers said on Tuesday that they had breached the FBI, stealing data on a large number of current and former FBI employees. ShinyHunters said it is holding the data hostage until the bureau rescinds an unflattering statement about the group issued in May.
Former FBI counterintelligence operative Eric O’Neill said the data allegedly stolen by ShinyHunters was “a foreign intelligence service goldmine.”
“China would be incredibly interested to know the individuals who are working against it,” said O’Neill, who founded the cybersecurity company Nexasure AI after [USN:N23346564 TEXT:"his stint at the bureau"]. He predicted that other hostile intelligence services would be eager to get their hands on the data, along with disgruntled extremists in the United States.
“If I were on that list I would be very concerned,” he said.
ShinyHunters said in a statement Wednesday that it was trying to keep the personnel information from circulating widely in the meantime.
“If the 5,000 sample data records leak, it’s not because of us,” the group said.
Although Reuters has not been able to authenticate the entire spreadsheet, it has been able to individually verify the details of more than 22 people by cross-referencing information in the hacked data with credit records and previous data leaks carried by the dark web intelligence platform District 4 Labs.
COUNTERTERRORISM, COUNTERINTELLIGENCE AND SURVEILLANCE Some of the assignment details in the ShinyHunters’ data are indistinguishable from what employees themselves might say publicly, noting agents at field offices in Baltimore or Newark, New Jersey, for example.
But in some cases, the data referred to FBI units or initiatives that were sensitive or whose existence has not previously been disclosed.
The data names 14 staffers focused on China-related matters, including members of the “China criminal enterprise unit,” the “China tech transfer analysis unit,” and the “China intelligence section.”
Nine others are listed as serving in Russia-related roles, including two in the “Russia Operations Section” and one working on “Russia Critical Infra and Tech Threat.” Three people are listed as working in Iran- or Hezbollah-focused intelligence roles.
Eighteen others are listed as working with “data intercept” or “telecom intercept” technologies, or in the FBI’s “clandestine technical operations” unit, or its “covert access section,” or in video, audio, or electronic surveillance roles.
A further 11 FBI staffers are listed as working in HUMINT, or human intelligence, jobs, including several listed as working in the “Humint program management section.”
Trevor Hilligoss, a former Army investigator who worked with the FBI, said the information tying specific named people to human intelligence work was particularly troubling.
“You don’t have to look far to find examples of undercover agents being harmed when their cover is blown,” he said.
Hilligoss, now the chief intelligence officer for cybersecurity company SpyCloud, said his concerns were heightened by the inclusion of emergency contacts – often spouses or children – “who may have less operational security knowledge than their relative that works in a sensitive field.”
Reuters could not verify that all the job assignments were authentic or up-to-date, but it was able to match the career details or titles of eight people whose data was leaked to information in court filings, news articles, or public profiles on LinkedIn or to online posts on sites such as Instagram.
OTHER TARGETS ShinyHunters previously claimed credit for the purported theft of [USN:L6N40W1A9 TEXT:"millions of business records"] from video game developer Rockstar Games, the maker of "Grand Theft Auto," and an intrusion focused on the [USN:L6N41P0Z6 TEXT:"education tool Canvas"] that triggered widespread disruption [USN:L6N41L0UT TEXT:"across U.S. schools"].
In May, the FBI said ShinyHunters sometimes used “exaggerated claims of access to sensitive or personal information to prompt payment from victims.”
ShinyHunters said its "threats and claims are very real,” adding that the FBI's statement was why it targeted the bureau.
Reuters has not been able to verify what else the hackers are holding. ShinyHunters previously told Reuters they obtained files related to the vetting of employees and applicants, the contracting of background investigations, and agents' sensitive medical data, but said on Wednesday it would not release any further data.
O’Neill, the former FBI operative, cautioned against drawing conclusions about what the hackers hold.
“They’re really trying to scare the hell out of the FBI,” he noted.
items.raw_description: FBI data allegedly stolen by the hacking group ShinyHunters carries granular detail about scores of bureau officials’ job assignments, including sensitive work against Chinese spies, Russian intelligence, drug cartels, and more, Reuters has found.

items.title: BHP dice detiene operaciones de mina chilena Escondida tras muerte de trabajador
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La minera global BHP dijo el miércoles que todas las actividades operacionales de la mina Escondida en Chile, el mayor yacimiento mundial de cobre, se encuentran suspendidas tras un accidente que dejó un trabajador fallecido.
items.body:
La minera global BHP dijo el miércoles que todas las actividades operacionales de la mina Escondida en Chile, el mayor yacimiento mundial de cobre, se encuentran suspendidas tras un accidente que dejó un trabajador fallecido.
El presidente del sindicato de trabajadores, Sebastián Liberona, había confirmado más temprano a Reuters el deceso del trabajador, ocurrido mientras realizaba labores de mantenimiento.
"La compañía informó de inmediato a la autoridad y activó los protocolos internos correspondientes. Todas las actividades operacionales de la mina se encuentran suspendidas", dijo en un comunicado.
De acuerdo a la normativa chilena, las mineras solo pueden retomar sus actividades tras un accidente fatal una vez que se realizan las labores periciales y los inspectores verifican que las condiciones son seguras para retomar labores.
La empresa agregó que inició una investigación para esclarecer las causas.
En tanto, el sindicato de trabajadores -donde pertenecía el trabajador- pidió a las autoridades administrativas y judiciales una investigación exhaustiva. "Las presiones por la continuidad operacional y productividad no pueden significar la falta de control de graves riesgos", señaló en un comunicado posterior.
Escondida está ubicada en el desierto de Atacama. BHP controla el yacimiento, que tiene como socios a Rio Tinto (RIO.L) y la japonesa JECO.

items.title: StoneX reduz previsão de safra de cana 26/27 do centro-sul e vê recorde para 27/28
items.author: Roberto Samora, Isabel Teles
items.creator: Roberto Samora, Isabel Teles
items.summary: O centro-sul do Brasil, região que responde por mais de 90% da cana-de-açúcar processada no país, deverá ter uma moagem menor do que a esperada em 2026/27 devido a chuvas que impactam as operações, mas que por outro lado vão aumentar os volumes disponíveis e a produtividade no próximo ciclo (2027/28), que veria uma safra recorde, estimou nesta quarta-feira a consultoria e corretora StoneX.
items.body:
O centro-sul do Brasil, região que responde por mais de 90% da cana-de-açúcar processada no país, deverá ter uma moagem menor do que a esperada em 2026/27 devido a chuvas que impactam as operações, mas que por outro lado vão aumentar os volumes disponíveis e a produtividade no próximo ciclo (2027/28), que veria uma safra recorde, estimou nesta quarta-feira a consultoria e corretora StoneX.
Uma visão de preço de açúcar mais vantajoso do que o valor equivalente do etanol terá impacto no "mix" de produção das usinas em 2027/28 (abril/março), levando o setor a destinar mais matéria-prima para a fabricação do adoçante no período, destacou a StoneX, em sua primeira estimativa para o novo ciclo.
Enquanto isso, a expansão da indústria de etanol de milho garante uma produção recorde para o biocombustível, segundo a consultoria. Todo o cenário ainda deve garantir maior oferta de açúcar para o Brasil, maior produtor e exportador global da commodity.
De acordo com a StoneX, o tempo chuvoso no inverno do centro-sul, associado ao fenômeno climático El Niño, prejudica o montante total a ser colhido de cana em 2026/27, cujo volume foi revisado de 640,1 milhões para 635,3 milhões de toneladas --ainda um crescimento de 3,9% sobre 2025/26.
Mas possibilita um "início firme" da temporada 2027/28, ajudando a elevar as toneladas de cana por hectare (TCH) e o próprio volume de cana. Assim, a companhia projeta uma moagem total de 662,1 milhões de toneladas para o novo ciclo.
"A grosso modo, o ciclo 27/28 será marcado pelo alto volume de chuvas e seus benefícios ao rendimento agrícola, e pela perspectiva de crescimento do mix açucareiro e, consequentemente, da oferta de açúcar, que pode subir 2,4 milhões de toneladas em 27/28 e se aproximar do recorde de 23/24", disse a StoneX.
Em relatório escrito por Marcelo Di Bonifacio Filho e Letícia Corrêa, a consultoria disse que, com os dias perdidos de colheita até o momento em 2026/27, e considerando uma entressafra chuvosa, a área colhida deverá cair neste ano 3,1%, para 7,96 milhões de hectares.
A safra de cana só não cai ante o ano anterior pelo ganho de produtividade, estimada em 79,8 toneladas por hectare em 2026/27, versus 74,4 em 2025/26.
Já a estimativa de produção de açúcar 2027/28 ficou em 42,4 milhões de toneladas, aumento de 11,6% ante 2026/27, que teve um cenário de preços mais favorável à fabricação de etanol em parte do período, segundo a consultoria.
"Mesmo considerando estoques finais (de açúcar) em 27/28 subindo 8%, com um consumo interno de 8,43 milhões de toneladas, as exportações têm potencial para atingir 33,8 milhões de toneladas via centro-sul no calendário abril-março, aumentando de forma robusta a oferta para o 'trade flow' global no segundo semestre de 2027", disseram os analistas.
O contexto atual dos preços de açúcar e etanol justifica aumento do "mix" açucareiro para 49,3% em 2027/28, alta de 3,1 pontos percentuais ante 2026/27.
A produção de açúcar em 2027/28 cresce também com o maior volume de matéria-prima disponível, com a produtividade agrícola superando 80 toneladas por hectare.
"A decisão de 'mix' das usinas em 27/28 será impactada pela dinâmica atual de preços do açúcar", disseram os analistas.
Eles lembraram que já em julho, o açúcar passou a ficar mais vantajoso que o etanol no Estado de São Paulo, principalmente por conta das quedas observadas nos preços do biocombustível após a entrada da safra 26/27. "Posteriormente, já em agosto, o rally de preços do Nova York passou a estimular não somente o mix açucareiro na temporada corrente, mas também para os contratos de 2027."
PRODUÇÃO DE ETANOL AINDA CRESCE, COM O MILHO Com o setor favorecendo o açúcar, o "mix" de cana para etanol cairá para 50,7% em 2027/28.
Ainda assim, a produção de etanol total (de cana e milho) deverá crescer 7,2% em 2027/28 ante o ciclo anterior para 40,5 bilhões de litros, com a oferta do biocombustível de milho compensando a queda esperada de 1,5% no volume do combustível de cana.
A produção de etanol de milho deverá saltar 29,7% em 2027/28, para 13,6 bilhões de litros.
"A safra 2027/28 será marcada por renovação do recorde da produção de etanol no centro-sul, puxado, claro, pela expansão acelerada do etanol de milho", disse a StoneX, citando que entre outubro de 2026 e março de 2028 serão oito novas unidades entrando em operação e outras cinco com programação de expansão de capacidade.
A capacidade de produção de etanol de milho deve começar abril de 2027 com 38,9 mil m³/dia e finalizar março de 2028 com 51,2 mil m³/dia, acrescentou.
items.raw_description: O centro-sul do Brasil, região que responde por mais de 90% da cana-de-açúcar processada no país, deverá ter uma moagem menor do que a esperada em 2026/27 devido a chuvas que impactam as operações, mas que por outro lado vão aumentar os volumes disponíveis e a produtividade no próximo ciclo (2027/28), que veria uma safra recorde, estimou nesta quarta-feira a consultoria e corretora StoneX.

items.title: US CDC confirms first measles-related death of 2026, does not disclose state
items.author: Siddhi Mahatole
items.creator: Siddhi Mahatole
items.summary: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported that there was one US measles-related death on its website on Wednesday, weeks after Pennsylvania health officials reported the first two of four measles-associated deaths in its state.
items.body:
The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported that there was one US measles-related death on its website on Wednesday, weeks after Pennsylvania health officials reported the first two of four measles-associated deaths in its state.
The CDC had not confirmed those deaths and raised questions about whether they were due to measles. The US has had 3,471 measles cases this year as of September 17, according to the agency.
The US Department of Health and Human Services spokesperson declined to confirm where the death had occurred. The US health agency said it had received a report from a state in which measles was listed as the underlying cause of death and that its National Center for Health Statistics had verified the death.
A Bloomberg News report said the death reported by the CDC on Wednesday was one of the Pennsylvania deaths.
"A standardized definition (of measles-related death) is very important, so that the cases can be counted objectively. If different agencies count deaths differently, it is very confusing and leads to a lack of transparency and trust," said Kawsar Talaat, associate professor at Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health.
Pennsylvania, the hardest hit from the outbreak, has reported [USN:L4N4571A0 TEXT:"four measles-associated deaths"] so far this year, and had 835 cases as of September 23. The state's health department did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
The deaths have become the focus of a public dispute between Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro and US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., who has said only one of the deaths resulted from measles.
The agency said last week it was working with the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists to develop a standardized case definition for measles deaths, as the outbreak grows across the country.
This work is intended to promote consistent classification and reporting of measles deaths across jurisdictions, HHS said.
The agency shifted to using mortality data from the National Center for Health Statistics for its national measles death count, moving away from its reliance on state health departments — a change that has drawn scrutiny.

items.title: モルガンSの投資銀案件リスト流出、従業員が誤送信－SNSにも画像
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米モルガン･スタンレーがアジアで獲得を目指している、または動向を追っている100件余りの投資銀行案件を記載した内部文書を同行の従業員が誤って流出させた。事情に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。同行が手掛けようとしている案件の詳細が露呈した格好となった。

ブルームバーグ･ニュースが入手し、関係者らが内容を確認した資料によると、リストには中国や韓国、インドなどの新規株式公開（IPO）候補企業が挙げられていた。リストはアジア地域が中心だが、欧州や中東、アフリカにも及んでおり、こうした企業を支援するプライベートエクイティー（PE）投資会社や年金基金のほか、棚上げされた案件に関する情報も載っていた。

関係者によると、同行の従業員が今週、この案件リストを電子メールで送信し、その後メールの取り消しを試みた。さらに、ぼかしが入った同文書の画像がインスタグラムのアカウントに投稿されていた。

モルガン･スタンレーはブルームバーグ･ニュースへの声明で、顧客情報の機密保持を極めて重視しているとし、「今回の不注意による情報共有に対処するため速やかに措置を講じ、引き続き関係者と協議している」と述べた。

今回の情報流出は、香港での株式売り出しの引き受けやアジアの合併案件で長年にわたり上位に名を連ねてきたモルガン･スタンレーにとって痛恨の失態だ。投資銀部門では通常、見込み顧客の取引詳細は厳重に管理されている。

顧客や関係者がモルガン･スタンレーに連絡したかどうかや、同行がこの問題に具体的にどう対応しているかは明らかになっていない。

原題：Morgan Stanley Investment-Bank Deal List Leaked in Email Misfire

items.title: Conagra shareholders vote for proposed changes to executive pay
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Conagra Brands shareholders voted on Wednesday in favour of proposed changes to the US packaged food maker's executive compensation program.
items.body:
Conagra Brands (CAG.N) shareholders voted on Wednesday in favour of proposed changes to the US packaged food maker's executive compensation program.
Proxy adviser ISS had urged shareholders to vote against the changes, citing concerns about declining financial performance and a lack of clarity around targets.
Here are more details:
The proposal was approved on an advisory basis at Conagra's AGM.
CEO John Brase's compensation package includes a $1.15 million base salary, an annual incentive target opportunity equal to 150% of his eligible base salary and $7.3 million in annual long-term incentives, consisting of 60% performance shares and 40% restricted stock units(RSUs), [USN:L6N44Z0MX TEXT:"as Conagra had proposed"] in a proxy statement on August 11.
Conagra, which makes Hunt's ketchup, Slim Jim meat sticks and Swiss Miss hot cocoa, halved its annual dividend in July and is reviewing its non-core assets under new CEO Brase after issuing a weak profit outlook.
Conagra Brands is expected to report its first-quarter results on September 30.

items.author: CNA

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine is ready for a ceasefire in the Black Sea and is waiting for Russia’s response.

UNITED NATIONS: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told leaders at the United Nations on Wednesday (Sep 23) that Ukraine was ready for a maritime truce in the Black Sea based on proposals by Egypt, India and Türkiye and said it was now up to Russia to respond .
Zelenskyy spoke at Ukraine 's Crimean Platform summit on the sidelines of the annual UN General Assembly gathering of world leaders and ahead of a Security Council meeting on Russia 's war in Ukraine , which is now in its fifth year.
Ukraine , which fears that Russia plans to pound power and heating facilities with missiles and drones this winter, has been pressing for ceasefires covering attacks on energy infrastructure and shipping in the Black Sea.
Zelenskyy said Egypt, India and Türkiye had outlined options to restore safe navigation for merchant shipping in the Black Sea, where cargo movements are at a near st and still due to heavy attacks on ships and port infrastructure by both sides.

"We are waiting for Russia 's response. Ukraine is ready ... to ensure safe shipping and food security in the Black Sea if Russia is ready to take real steps towards de-escalation too. We have to start somewhere," he said.
Top wheat importers in Asia, the Middle East and Africa that count on the Black Sea region for wheat have been finding it hard to secure supplies. Global wheat prices have soared.
Zelenskyy , who was expected to address the UN General Assembly later on Wednesday, met US President Donald Trump on Tuesday and said they had also discussed a Russia - Ukraine ceasefire on energy-related targets.

Related:

President tells Trump that Iran will never 'bend at the knee'

Russia pounds Kyiv with drone strikes after Zelenskyy-Trump talks

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio told reporters after meeting Russia n Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov on Wednesday that both Russia and Ukraine had expressed interest in a limited ceasefire involving grain and energy.
The Kremlin has not publicly backed the proposals.
Ahead of the Lavrov-Rubio meeting, the Kremlin said there were no grounds for wider Ukraine peace talks, while saying it remained open to such talks.
"For now, there are no prerequisites for moving on to a peaceful negotiating track, although we, as the Russia n side, remain open to peace talks," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters.
Zelenskyy said on Tuesday that he would be ready to meet Russia n President Vladimir Putin at a trilateral meeting with Trump.

Source: Reuters/fs

ROME, Sept 23 : Napoli President Aurelio De Laurentiis has a gift for turning football politics into cinema, and FIFA President Gianni Infantino found himself cast as both villain and hero in the Italian film producer's latest monologue on the state of the game.
Speaking after receiving a lifetime achievement award from Italy's Foreign Press Association on Wednesday, De Laurentiis stopped short of directly attacking Infantino, who has faced calls to resign after exploring a plan under which private investors would have bought shares in the World Cup and other competitions.
Instead, the Napoli owner offered a barbed assessment of the FIFA chief's rise and global profile before admitting he had been impressed by the staging of this year's World Cup.
"Infantino is someone who does his job from his point of view," De Laurentiis said during the ceremony in Rome.

"If a once secretary is then allowed, once he becomes president, to do certain things and travel around the world wearing the FIFA badge, meeting Trump, meeting Putin, meeting everyone, what are we supposed to say to him? We have to say: he is doing his job from his perspective.
"This year, when I went to watch the World Cup matches, you saw these stadiums organised in an extraordinary way… I wanted to shoot Infantino; but when I saw how he had organised everything, I said: 'No, I hold my hands up, I have to say well done.'"
EUROPE FOOTBALL'S POWER STRUCTURES
De Laurentiis, whose Napoli have won two Serie A titles and five domestic cups since he rescued the club from bankruptcy more than two decades ago, was less charitable about European football's power structures.
"Sport is not in crisis in the United States, which is still that shining beacon; it is in crisis in Europe," he said.
"What is the Europa League for? What is the Conference League for? To collect votes for those who then have to be re-elected within all those organisations which, as it happens, are beyond any legislative oversight, because they do whatever they want and, if you raise your head even slightly, they immediately want to cut it off.
"Look at what is happening at FIFA, look at what happened at UEFA in the past. There's a series from a few years ago, which tells the story of all FIFA's problems..."
De Laurentiis repeated his desire for Napoli to have a family-friendly stadium and said hard-core ultras had no place in that vision.
"I am against ultras, football must be about passion and educating children. You can’t have hooligans … or ‘ultras’ that are moulded from the Mafia, ’ndrangheta and Camorra,” De Laurentiis said, listing three of Italy’s organized crime syndicates.
“Until our police chiefs and government ministers get the situation under control it’s a major problem.”

Source: Reuters

items.title: Brasil tem fluxo cambial negativo de US$7,078 bilhões em setembro até dia 18, diz BC
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Brasil registrou fluxo cambial total negativo de US$7,078 bilhões em setembro até o dia 18, conforme dados divulgados nesta quarta-feira pelo Banco Central.
items.body:
O Brasil registrou fluxo cambial total negativo de US$7,078 bilhões em setembro até o dia 18, conforme dados divulgados nesta quarta-feira pelo Banco Central.
Pelo canal financeiro, houve saídas líquidas de US$6,839 bilhões em setembro até o dia 18. Por este canal são realizados os investimentos estrangeiros diretos e em carteira, as remessas de lucro e o pagamento de juros, entre outras operações.
Pelo canal comercial, que contabiliza exportações e importações, o saldo de setembro até o dia 18 foi negativo em US$240 milhões.
Os dados mais recentes do BC são preliminares e fazem parte das estatísticas referentes ao câmbio contratado.
SEMANA Na semana passada, de 14 a 18 de setembro, saíram líquidos do país US$1,091 bilhão.
No acumulado do ano até 18 de setembro, o Brasil registra fluxo cambial total positivo de US$8,714 bilhões.

items.title: 米5年債利回り急上昇、2007年以来の5%台－指標堅調で利上げ継続観測
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米5年債利回りが約20年ぶりに5%を上回った。堅調な米経済指標を受け、インフレ圧力を抑えるため米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が利上げを継続するとの見方が強まった。

5年債利回りは23日に一時、前日比で20ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上昇して5.03%を付けた。FRBの利上げ局面がピークを迎えた2023年に4.99%を付けていたが、今回それを上回った。

S&Pグローバルがこの日発表した米製造業・サービス業活動を測る指標（速報値）が、市場予想の中央値を上回った。また、同日午後に実施された5年債入札は、最高落札利回りが06年以来の高水準となった。

5年債利回りは23日に一時、前日比で20ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上昇して5.03%を付けた。FRBの利上げ局面がピークを迎えた2023年に4.99%を付けていたが、今回それを上回った。

S&Pグローバルがこの日発表した米製造業・サービス業活動を測る指標（速報値）が、市場予想の中央値を上回った。また、同日午後に実施された5年債入札は、最高落札利回りが06年以来の高水準となった。

items.title: MPS investors can back defence plan and still accept Intesa's offer, CEO says
items.author: Valentina Za
items.creator: Valentina Za
items.summary: Monte dei Paschi Chief Executive Luigi Lovaglio urged investors in the Italian bank to back his defence strategy against a takeover bid by Intesa Sanpaolo even if they intend to tender their shares under the offer.
items.body:
Monte dei Paschi (BMPS.MI) Chief Executive Luigi Lovaglio urged investors in the Italian bank to back his defence strategy against a takeover bid by Intesa Sanpaolo (ISP.MI) even if they intend to tender their shares under the offer.
Addressing a Bank of America investor conference in London, Lovaglio said an October 29 vote on the defence plan should not be seen as a choice between Intesa's bid and the alternative deal MPS is proposing.
"It's not a moment where you decide about one deal or the other," Lovaglio said.
Under Italian rules, the management of a company targeted by a bid needs shareholder approval to proceed with any moves that could thwart the takeover.
To fend off the €36 billion cash-and-share offer, MPS is proposing buying rival mid-sized commercial bank Banco BPM (BAMI.MI) as well as wealth manager Banca Generali (BGN.MI) in two all-share deals worth in aggregate €38 billion.
Lovaglio said that backing the defence strategy would give MPS's management the chance to better define and explain the plan to shareholders.
The market's response to the defence plan has been poor. However, Lovaglio said that by having an alternative on the table, shareholders stood a better chance of extracting a higher price from Intesa.
Intesa, whose offer includes €4 billion in cash on top of the share component, has ruled out raising the price.
Shareholder approval for Lovaglio's plan would complicate matters for Intesa, whose buyout offer is due to start only in November after clearing regulatory hurdles.
Intesa is counting on concluding its bid before the two MPS bids go live.
Given the binding nature of such bids once launched, Intesa needs to get control of MPS before the tender period for the two MPS offers starts.

items.title: 米国、ディーゼル輸出を90日間禁止する計画を策定中－ポリティコ
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米ホワイトハウスは、ディーゼル燃料の輸出を90日間禁止する計画を策定している。政治ニュースサイトのポリティコが匿名の関係者の情報を基に報じた。

ポリティコによると、実際に禁止するための法的手続きはなお不透明だが、トランプ大統領は週末までに禁止措置を打ち出す意向だ。禁止措置が導入されれば、高騰する燃料費の抑制に向けたトランプ政権のこれまでで最も踏み込んだ措置となる。

イランとウクライナでの戦争を背景にディーゼル価格が過去最高水準に上昇する中、トランプ氏は今週、米国のディーゼル輸出禁止を支持するよう側近らに促したと述べていた。ただ、エネルギー業界関係者は、輸出規制による価格押し下げ効果は短期的なものにとどまり、その後は燃料費が一段と上昇するとして、規制の可能性に強く反対している。

全米自動車協会（AAA）によると、米国のディーゼル小売価格は過去最高値を更新し、1ガロン当たり6.50ドルを超えた。

items.title: Rendimiento de bonos del Tesoro a cinco años supera el 5% por primera vez en casi dos décadas
items.author: Greg Ritchie
items.summary: El rendimiento llegó al 5,03% después de que datos económicos sólidos reforzaran las expectativas de nuevas subidas de tasas de la Reserva Federal.
items.body: Bloomberg — La rentabilidad de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense a cinco años superó el 5% por primera vez en casi dos décadas, ya que los sólidos datos económicos de Estados Unidos impulsaron a los inversores a prepararse para una serie de subidas de las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal para frenar las presiones inflacionarias. La tasa de interés de los bonos de referencia subió 20 puntos básicos el miércoles, hasta el 5,03%. Esto supera el máximo del 4,99% alcanzado en 2023, en el punto álgido del ciclo de subida de tasas de la Reserva Federal para frenar la creciente inflación. Ver más: ¿Vuelve la cartera 60/40? Goldman Sachs analiza el peor ciclo de los bonos en un siglo Las expectativas de un mayor endurecimiento de la política monetaria aumentaron el miércoles después de que los indicadores preliminares de S&P Global sobre la actividad manufacturera y de servicios en Estados Unidos, publicados en septiembre, superaran las estimaciones promedio. Esto incrementó la presión en el mercado de bonos, y la venta de bonos a cinco años del Tesoro estadounidense el miércoles registró el mayor rendimiento en subasta desde 2006. La semana pasada, los funcionarios de la Reserva Federal votaron por unanimidad a favor de subir las tasas de interés en septiembre por primera vez desde 2023, situando la tasa de referencia de los fondos federales en un rango de entre el 3,75% y el 4%. El presidente Kevin Warsh afirmó que esta medida eliminó una “dosis de estímulo”. Los operadores apuestan por cuatro subidas más en los próximos 12 meses. Los responsables políticos están cada vez más preocupados por la inflación, que no ha alcanzado su objetivo del 2% en cinco años y medio, y algunos advierten de presiones inflacionarias que parecen persistir. Todo esto ocurre en un contexto de un mercado laboral estadounidense sólido. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: A pedido da AGU, CNJ ordena devolução de R$4,7 bi ao Tesouro em processos do setor sucroalcooleiro
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ) decidiu que seja feita a devolução de R$4,7 bilhões à Conta Única do Tesouro Nacional, acrescidos dos respectivos rendimentos, com o cancelamento de 16 precatórios de processos do setor sucroalcooleiro, atendendo a um pedido da Advocacia Geral da União (AGU), que divulgou a determinação nesta quarta-feira.
items.body:
O Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ) decidiu que seja feita a devolução de R$4,7 bilhões à Conta Única do Tesouro Nacional, acrescidos dos respectivos rendimentos, com o cancelamento de 16 precatórios de processos do setor sucroalcooleiro, atendendo a um pedido da Advocacia Geral da União (AGU), que divulgou a determinação nesta quarta-feira.
A decisão foi proferida pelo corregedor nacional de Justiça, ministro Benedito Gonçalves, em pedido de providências apresentado pela União contra o Tribunal Regional Federal da 1ª Região (TRF-1). O CNJ reconheceu a existência de risco de dano ao erário e determinou o imediato cumprimento da medida, segundo o comunicado.
"Os valores, que somam R$4.738.065.026,73, estavam depositados em contas judiciais desde dezembro de 2023, vinculados a precatórios expedidos antes do trânsito em julgado da fase processual de execução. Segundo o CNJ, essa modalidade de 'precatório bloqueado' não possui amparo legal e contraria decisão anterior do próprio Conselho", disse a AGU, em nota da assessoria de comunicação.
A decisão cautelar do CNJ suspendeu decisões da presidência do TRF-1 que impediam o cancelamento das ordens formais de pagamento e restabeleceu determinações da 6ª Vara Federal Cível do Distrito Federal para devolução dos recursos. O tribunal terá cinco dias para cancelar os precatórios e restituir os valores, com seus rendimentos, ao Tesouro Nacional.
"A medida representa um passo relevante para o restabelecimento das contas públicas, ao permitir que recursos bilionários, mantidos fora da Conta Única e da programação financeira da União desde 2023, retornem ao Tesouro e possam ser novamente incorporados à gestão financeira do Estado. O próprio CNJ destacou que a manutenção dessa situação representava risco de lesão ao erário", disse a AGU.
Procurada, a assessoria de comunicação do TRF-1 não respondeu de imediato a pedido de comentário.

items.title: トランプ氏、ベネズエラ暫定大統領と債務再編を協議＝米国務長官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領はベネズエラのロドリゲス暫定大統領と２２日に行った会談で、ベネズエラが抱える巨額の政府債務の再編について協議した。ルビオ米国務長官が２３日、明らかにした。

ロドリゲス氏は、米軍が今年１月に急襲作戦で当時のマドゥロ大統領を拘束して以降、初めて訪米。トランプ氏との会談は２２日夜、国連総会に合わせてトランプ氏がニューヨークで主催したレセプションの席上で行われた。 

ルビオ氏は記者団に対し、トランプ氏とロドリゲス氏の会談は「短時間だったが重要な会談だった」と述べた。

その上で「ベネズエラが成功するには多くの問題を解決しなければならない。債務再編がその鍵になる」と指摘。ベネズエラはおそらく世界最大規模の再編が必要な政府債務を抱えているとし、米国が支援する意向を示すと同時に、「適切な方法で進めなければならない」と述べた。

ベネズエラ政府と国営石油会社ベネズエラ石油（ＰＤＶＳＡ）は、現在デフォルト（債務不履行）状態にある約６００億ドルの債券を抱えている。アナリストは、未払いの利息や仲裁裁定による支払い義務などを含めると、債務総額は１５００億ドルを超える可能性があると試算している。

items.title: Huracán Polo desciende a categoría 4 mientras bordea las costas del Pacífico de México
items.author: Brian K. Sullivan
items.summary: Se prevé que el huracán se desvíe bruscamente de tierra firme, pero que permanezca lo suficientemente cerca de la costa con riesgo de inundaciones en Guerrero y Michoacán.
items.body: Bloomberg — El huracán Polo se debilitó durante la noche mientras seguía rozando la costa del Pacífico de México, que se espera que evite un impacto directo. Los vientos de Polo descendieron a 150 millas (241 kilómetros) por hora desde las 180 mph registradas el martes, lo que lo convierte en una tormenta de categoría 4 en la escala de Saffir-Simpson, que consta de cinco niveles, según informó el Centro Nacional de Huracanes de EE.UU. El huracán se encontraba a unas 320 millas (515 kilómetros) al sureste del importante puerto de carga de Manzanillo, aproximadamente a las 6 de la mañana, hora de la Ciudad de México. Se prevé que el huracán se desvíe bruscamente de tierra firme, pero que permanezca lo suficientemente cerca de la costa como para que los vientos con fuerza de tormenta tropical y las fuertes lluvias aumenten el riesgo de inundaciones en los estados mexicanos de Guerrero y Michoacán hasta el jueves, según escribió Jack Beven, especialista sénior en huracanes del centro estadounidense, en un informe de previsiones. “Según la trayectoria prevista, se espera que el núcleo de Polo se encuentre cerca de la costa del suroeste de México durante el próximo día o los dos próximos días, aunque se prevé que permanezca en alta mar”, afirmó Beven. En su momento de mayor intensidad, los vientos de Polo alcanzaron las 180 mph, lo que lo sitúa a la par de los supertifones Bavi y Sinlaku como las tormentas más fuertes del Pacífico de este año, según Phil Klotzbach, investigador de huracanes de la Universidad Estatal de Colorado. El Niño y una zona anómalamente cálida del Pacífico cerca de México y California han contribuido a avivar las tormentas en todo el océano desde la pasada primavera. La activa temporada del Pacífico también ha traído tormentas mortales más al oeste. El tifón Dujuan dejó al menos nueve muertos y cuatro desaparecidos cerca de Tokio. La presidenta mexicana, Claudia Sheinbaum, instó a los residentes de la costa a permanecer alerta por si la tormenta cambia de rumbo. El Centro de Huracanes de EE.UU. indicó que Polo podría trazar una trayectoria en forma de arco a través del Pacífico oriental y acercarse a la costa de Baja California (México) mientras aún mantiene la intensidad de un huracán a principios de la próxima semana. --Con la colaboración de Gonzalo Soto, Alice French y Hideki Suzuki.

items.title: イラン大統領「降伏せず」、外交重視　国連演説中に米代表団退席
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［国連　２３日　ロイター］ - イランのペゼシュキアン大統領は２３日、国連本部で開かれている国連総会の一般討論演説で、トランプ米大統領の姿勢を「弱い者いじめの姿勢」だと批判し、米国との戦争でイランが降伏することはないと述べた。
items.body:
［国連　２３日　ロイター］ - イランのペゼシュキアン大統領は２３日、国連本部で開かれている国連総会の一般討論演説で、トランプ米大統領の姿勢を「弱い者いじめの姿勢」だと批判し、米国との戦争でイランが降伏することはないと述べた。 同時に、戦争終結に向けて外交を重視する姿勢も強調した。

ペゼシュキアン氏は、脅しはイランの決意を一層固めさせるだけだと主張し、合意に至らなければイランを壊滅させ得るとするトランプ氏の警告を一蹴。「米大統領の昨日の発言は弱い者いじめの姿勢の表れだ。イラン国民が圧力に屈することはない。テロリストであり、テロリストを訓練している者たちが、われわれをテロリスト呼ばわりしている」と反論した。

ペゼシュキアン氏は演説の中で幾度も、イランは交渉を通じて米国との緊張を解決する用意があると述べつつ、イラン政府は力による威圧を受け入れないと警告した。

また、米国はいかなる国際法も尊重していないと非難。イランは米国や敵対勢力に対抗するため、強く力強い国家でなければならないと述べた。

ペゼシュキアン氏の演説が始まると、米国の代表団は退席した。国連の米政府代表部はコメントの要請に直ちには応じなかった。

演説の冒頭でペゼシュキアン氏は、戦争中に米国が民間人を殺害したと非難し、教室にいる女子生徒を写した写真などを掲げた。

イラン当局によると、２月２８日のイラン攻撃初日、南部ミナブにある学校が攻撃され、児童や教員１７５人以上が死亡した。

米国防総省は、ミナブへの攻撃に関する調査結果を公表していない。この攻撃は、米軍が関与した民間人被害としては数十年で最悪の事案となった。ロイターは３月５日、米軍による初期の内部調査で、この攻撃は米軍によるものである可能性が高いとの結論が出たと報じた。

ペゼシュキアン氏は、イランに核爆弾を追求する意図はないが、平和的な核開発の権利を放棄することはないと言明。「核兵器も持たなければ、核の知見を手放すこともない」と述べた。

世界の石油と液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）の５分の１が通過するホルムズ海峡は、イランと米国の緊張の焦点となっている。

ペゼシュキアン氏は「誰もがホルムズ海峡から恩恵を受ける一方で、われわれだけがこの水路を通じた海運へのアクセスを拒まれるようなことはあってはならない。敵対的な艦隊の恒久的な展開や戦争の拡大が、平和につながることはない」と述べた。

items.title: As 5% Treasury yields lose shock value, investors start worrying about 6%
items.author: Marc Jones, Naomi Rovnick
items.creator: Marc Jones, Naomi Rovnick
items.summary: For years, 5% on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury yield was viewed as the point at which global financial markets would start hitting turbulence. That threshold is beginning to look less like a ceiling and more like a waypoint.
items.body:
For years, 5% on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury yield was viewed as the point at which global financial markets would start hitting turbulence. That threshold is beginning to look less like a ceiling and more like a waypoint.
This month's breach of 5% - something that has happened only briefly in recent decades - has forced investors to contemplate an unsettling question: What if 6% is the new number that should be keeping them awake at night?
The latest move above 5% has not lasted long enough yet to properly test that theory. But it has always been a psychological marker rather than an automatic tripwire, according to BlueBay Asset Management's head of market strategy, Mike Bell.
"People think of it as if there's a magic number for Treasury yields at which it becomes a problem, (but) it's a relative number, not an absolute number," Bell explained.
What matters is how Treasury yields compare with other key investment metrics, particularly the earnings yield on stocks. Bell says that relationship is now approaching an inflection point, potentially setting the stage for an equity selloff.
History offers some guidance. MSCI's main world stocks index (.MIWD00000PUS) halved in value the last time the 10-year Treasury yield broke 5%, which was just before the global financial crash. It suffered a similar slump less than a decade earlier when a near 6.8% spike helped pop the dotcom bubble.
JP Morgan's analysts say one of the reasons why the pain-point might now be above 5% again is a "key structural shift" in the global economy, with AI, healthcare and services playing a bigger role. Many of those firms are spending and expanding, regardless of the level of borrowing costs.
That means "the traditional interest-rate channel looks materially less binding" and the "breaking threshold" of stock markets may be "meaningfully higher, potentially in the 5.5%-6.0% range", JP Morgan said, referencing the views of some of the major investors at one of its most recent conferences.
PROFOUND REPRICING In the $29-trillion Treasury market, which anchors pricing for virtually all financial assets, a shift from 5% to 6% would represent a profound adjustment in the global cost of capital.
A 6% Treasury yield would imply either significantly higher inflation expectations, growing concerns about US fiscal sustainability, a conviction that interest rates will remain elevated for years - or a mix of all three.
Federal Reserve policymaker Austan Goolsbee said this week that he didn't know whether markets would react differently to a lengthier period of 5% yields than they had in the past.
Paul Jackson, Invesco global head of asset allocation research, said investors focus on Treasury yields for a simple reason: Treasuries represent the world's risk-free benchmark and at above 5%, investors can lock in the highest returns on US bonds since 2007.
Jackson's own calculations show world stocks start to drop when the 10-year yield has traded at an average of 4.72% for 12 months and then rises.
That tipping point remains some way off for now - the 12-month average is currently around 4.34% - but Jackson said he was already dialling back on stocks and switching some money into government bonds to cash in on the juicy yields.
"If Treasury yields keep rising then there is a risk that the stock market is lower in 12 months' time," he said.
EMERGING QUESTIONS Emerging markets, which have enjoyed something of a hot streak in recent years, are often among the first casualties when US yields surge.
Higher Treasury returns tend to strengthen the dollar and make dollar-denominated assets more attractive. That sucks capital away from EM economies and can tip hard-up countries into crisis if the cost of servicing their dollar-denominated debt spirals.
Data on investment flows shows last week saw the biggest exodus from EM bond funds in months, with billions also withdrawn from equity funds. Issuance of emerging-market sovereign debt has also been notably lighter than usual this month.
"It's not an optimal picture for EM," said Alison Shimada, Head of Total Emerging Markets Equity, Allspring Global Investments, although she stressed that for now nothing was going "horribly wrong" and therefore remained "constructive".
Perhaps the biggest risk is psychological.
Once investors start asking whether 6% is attainable, the debate shifts beyond a temporary spike in yields. It becomes a broader reckoning with the possibility that the era of abundant liquidity and ultra-cheap money has ended, forcing global asset prices to adapt to a permanently higher cost of capital.
Premier Miton CIO Neil Birrell said while stock markets were showing no sign of collapsing right now, that might be because investors weren't yet plugging in 5%-plus yields into their longer-term profit forecasting models.
"The markets look fine until everyone re-runs their valuation models," Birrell said. "Ultimately, the numbers are the numbers and they've got to come through."
items.raw_description: For years, 5% on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury yield was viewed as the point at which global financial markets would start hitting turbulence. That threshold is beginning to look less like a ceiling and more like a waypoint.

items.body:
Andrea Shalal

[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - ベセント米財務長官は２３日、米中首脳会談を２４日に控える中、中国の何立峰副首相と会談した。会談後、１１月１０日に期限を迎える米中間の「貿易休戦」の延長、あるいはより包括的な貿易協定の追求に前向きな姿勢を示した。

ベセント長官と何氏の会談は２０日に続き、今週２回目。

長官は記者団に対し、２０日の協議で「中国側がより大規模な合意案を提示してきた」と説明。２０２５年の韓国・釜山での米中首脳会談に言及し、「われわれは釜山合意の継続にも、より大きな合意の検討にもオープンだ」と語った。

この日の会談に先立ち、首脳会談に向けて「未解決の問題」 の整理が目的だと説明。「われわれは戦略的安定を望んでいるが、それは互恵性と公平性に基づく必要がある」と述べていた。

ベセント長官はその後、Ｘへの投稿で、何氏との協議を実質的なものだったと評した。さらに、財務省が「米国の経済的・国家安全保障上の利益を推進しつつ、米労働者、農家、企業を守る有意義なコミットメント」の確保に注力していると述べた。

情報筋もこの日の協議を「生産的かつ建設的だった」とし、「双方は引き続き積極的に関与し、一連の重要な課題を巡る協議は進展している」と述べた。

トランプ大統領と習近平国家主席は２４日に今年２回目の首脳会談を行う予定。前回会談は５月に北京で開かれた。

年後半に中国・深セン で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議や、米マイアミで開かれる２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）首脳会議に合わせて両首脳が再び会談する可能性もあり、ベセント長官は「今年は両首脳が最大４回会談する歴史的な年になる可能性がある」と述べた。

items.author: CNA
items.summary: Sept 23 : Meta's Muse, the first major consumer product to emerge under Alexandr Wang since he was hired to head its AI efforts last year, has split the fortunes of US stocks this week.Muse, which allows users to delegate tasks such as shopping, travel booking and form-filling to an AI agent, overtook ChatGPT

FAST

Sept 23 : Meta's Muse, the first major consumer product to emerge under Alexandr Wang since he was hired to head its AI efforts last year, has split the fortunes of US stocks this week.
Muse, which allows users to delegate tasks such as shopping, travel booking and form-filling to an AI agent, overtook ChatGPT as the top free app on Apple's App Store and Google Play Store in the US and Canada.
The app recorded 2.8 million downloads within two weeks of its launch, posting an average daily download growth of 55 per cent in the first 10 days, according to market intelligence company Sensor Tower.
Investors worried that Meta's scale could turn Muse into a powerful comparison-shopping tool, enabling consumers to more easily find lower-cost alternatives and weakening the loyalty that often keeps users with incumbent providers.

The development dragged on several sectors this week, while Meta and AI-infrastructure related companies rallied.
"Meta has really found lightning in a bottle here and someone who partners with Muse is likely to be a clear beneficiary off the bat to me. As far as net losers, it's just going to take more time to find out," said Michael O'Rourke, chief market strategist at JonesTrading.
JITTERS ACROSS SECTORS
Financials stocks were the hardest-hit in the previous session and remained under pressure on Wednesday on fears that the AI agent could prompt users to switch to policies with cheaper prices.
Big banks such as JPMorgan and Wells Fargo lost more than 3 per cent each so far this week, while brokerage Charles Schwab was down nearly 5 per cent. Insurers such as Marsh and Arthur J. Gallagher were down 2.4 per cent and 4.6 per cent, respectively.
Art Hogan, chief market strategist for B. Riley Wealth, however, said those disruption concerns were far-fetched.
"If you're going to trust the management of your finances to something that Muse found for you, then you were likely not a big payer to anyone in that industry to begin with. There's a whole lot more that goes in asset management than who's got the cheapest price," he said.
Booking companies such as TripAdvisor and Booking Holdings, which rely on subscription models, have lost over 6 per cent this week.
Planet Fitness has tanked 17 per cent, while the New York Times is down 10 per cent.
Other decliners included ride-hailing companies such as Uber and Lyft, and online food marketplace DoorDash.
THE BIGGEST WINNERS
Meta's shares have soared nearly 13 per cent this week and are set for their fifth-straight week of advances.
The gains were fueled by expectations that the mainstream consumer-focused app could generate additional annual revenue, with Truist Securities estimating it to touch at least $28.5 billion by fiscal 2030.
US-listed shares of Canada's Shopify have jumped 11.4 per cent this week, after it said it would use Muse to process checkouts. Payments platform PayPal has marginally gained after saying it would allow users to discover products and complete purchases through the AI agent.
Privately held companies, including Stripe and Ticketmaster, also struck similar deals with Meta.
MORE AI INFRASTRUCTURE DEMAND
Apps such as Muse could drive AI compute demand, accelerating AI infrastructure buildout and benefiting chip stocks.
The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index has gained 7 per cent since Muse's launch and is set for its biggest two-week run since mid-August, with Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices among top gainers.

Source: Reuters

items.body: Bloomberg — Harvey Weinstein fue condenado a 15 años de prisión por agresión sexual, lo que supone el último revés judicial para el magnate del cine convertido en símbolo del movimiento #MeToo tras casi una década de procesos judiciales. La sentencia, dictada este miércoles, se deriva de una condena dictada el año pasado en un tribunal penal del estado de Nueva York. Un jurado declaró al cofundador de Miramax culpable de obligar a la antigua asistente de producción de Project Runway, Miriam Haley, a mantener relaciones sexuales orales. El fiscal del distrito de Manhattan, Alvin Bragg, había solicitado 20 años. Weinstein había solicitado 9 años. Aunque Weinstein ha indicado que recurrirá la última condena y sentencia, esta supone, por el momento, el final de una larga batalla judicial liderada por la Fiscalía del Distrito de Manhattan para encarcelar a Weinstein, después de que una avalancha de acusaciones en su contra desencadenara un debate nacional sobre el abuso de las mujeres en el ámbito laboral. Ver más: Harvey Weinstein es declarado culpable de agresión sexual en Nueva York por segunda vez Lleva en prisión desde 2020, la mayor parte del tiempo en Rikers Island, en medio de procedimientos judiciales tanto en Nueva York como en California, donde también ha sido condenado por delitos sexuales. En unas declaraciones realizadas antes de que se dictara la sentencia, Weinstein le dijo al juez: “No soy una persona perfecta” y “pido sinceras disculpas a cualquiera a quien haya podido hacer daño con mis actos”, afirmando que siente “remordimiento por el dolor de Miriam Haley”. Sin embargo, añadió: “Debo reiterar mi inocencia”. Solicitó clemencia para poder pasar el resto de su vida con sus hijos y ayudar a otros reclusos. Haley también se dirigió al juez Curtis Farber y, con la voz quebrada, afirmó que haber sido agredida por Weinstein “me ha minado la autoestima”. Testificar en su contra ha sido “la peor decisión de mi vida”, añadió. “Me planteé retirarme tantas veces. Pero por cada persona que siente miedo, cansancio, intimidación o vergüenza, sabía que esas eran las razones por las que tenía que seguir adelante”. Weinstein, de 74 años, fue declarado inicialmente culpable en 2020 de agredir sexualmente a Haley y de violar a otra mujer, Jessica Mann, en un juicio celebrado en Nueva York que supuso un punto de inflexión para el movimiento #MeToo. Fue condenado a 23 años, pero el tribunal superior del estado de Nueva York anuló las condenas, alegando que el numeroso grupo de mujeres que testificaron sobre abusos no imputados privó a Weinstein de un juicio justo. Ver más: Harvey Weinstein apela su condena por violación ante el tribunal de Nueva York Weinstein fue declarado culpable de nuevo de agredir sexualmente a Haley en un nuevo juicio celebrado en 2025, que tuvo lugar en medio de un clima político cambiante y de un mayor escepticismo hacia el movimiento #MeToo. El jurado no logró alcanzar un veredicto por segunda vez respecto al cargo de haber violado a Mann. En otro nuevo juicio celebrado este año, el jurado volvió a no alcanzar un veredicto sobre el mismo cargo de violación. En junio, el fiscal del distrito de Manhattan, Alvin Bragg, archivó el caso de violación, por lo que Weinstein será condenado únicamente por agredir sexualmente a Haley. Weinstein también fue declarado culpable de violación y agresión sexual en California y condenado a 16 años de prisión por dichos delitos. Sin embargo, a principios de este año, un tribunal de apelación de California ordenó que se le volviera a dictar sentencia, alegando que el juez de primera instancia había tenido en cuenta un “factor agravante que ahora es inválido”. Ver más: Abdalá Bucaram fue condenado a más de nueve años de cárcel: qué dice el fallo y por qué Aún no se le ha vuelto a dictar sentencia en California, por lo que la pena de prisión de Nueva York es, actualmente, la única que le pesa. Su equipo de abogados ha declarado que solicitarán la revisión del caso de California ante el tribunal supremo de dicho estado. Weinstein, que en su día fue uno de los hombres más poderosos de la industria del entretenimiento, fue acusado por primera vez de delitos sexuales en 2018 en Nueva York, lo que llevó el movimiento #MeToo a los tribunales penales. Weinstein afirma que está luchando contra el cáncer y otras enfermedades. “Me parece una lenta marcha hacia mi muerte”, declaró Weinstein en una comparecencia ante el tribunal a principios de este año. “Mi estado mental se ha derrumbado. Vivo en una ansiedad constante”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Fed Governor Michael Barr signals more rate hikes needed to tame inflation
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr announced that additional rate hikes may be necessary to manage inflation. He indicated that while economic growth is strong, inflation remains above the target of 2%. The central bank recently raised the policy rate to a range of 3.75%-4.00%. Barr's perspective contrasts with the Fed Chairman, who has not provided guidance on future rates.
items.body: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr said on Wednesday that the central bank took an important step last week to recalibrate short-term borrowing costs in its effort to bring down inflation, and signalled that further rate hikes are likely needed, Reuters reported. Risks to achieving our inflation target have increased, while risks to the labour market have receded, Barr said in prepared remarks for a Chicago Fed housing affordability conference.He noted that US economic growth remains strong and the labour market solid, but inflation is still above the Fed's 2% goal and not clearly headed lower. In my base case, further policy adjustments are likely needed to ensure inflation comes down to target in a timely fashion, he said.For live updates on US Markets, click hereIn a unanimous decision last week, Fed policymakers raised the central bank's policy rate to a range of 3.75%-4.00%. Sixteen of 18 officials signalled that at least one more hike would likely be needed before year-end, according to a Reuters report.Barr's remarks suggest he sees the case for at least two further increases, though he did not specify a timeline.His willingness to be specific about the rate path stands in contrast to Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh, who has declined to offer any forward guidance on the matter. In my view, given changes to the economy, we were out of position, and we made an adjustment in the right direction, Barr added, referring to last week's quarter-point hike. We want to support sustainable, durable growth in support of maximum employment, and price stability is crucial to that. Barr's comments on monetary policy were brief, with most of his speech devoted to housing affordability, a problem he said has been compounded by a shortage of supply and elevated mortgage rates. The average rate on a 30-year fixed-rate mortgage in the US rose to 7.12% last week, its highest level in more than two years, the Mortgage Bankers Association said on Wednesday.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

BAKU, Sept 23 : McLaren’s reigning world champion Lando Norris on Wednesday described Formula One’s move to shorten races next year as a good, short-term compromise that would improve the racing action.
The governing FIA's Formula One commission on Monday agreed to reduce the standard Grand Prix distance from 305 km to 290 km from 2027, cutting races by two or three laps.
The move is aimed at ensuring drivers make it to the end of races without running out of fuel, with the fuel flow rate set to increase next year.
“It's a good compromise that we need to make to make our sport better and rely more on driving rather than who can look after our battery the best,” Briton Norris told reporters.

“I think in a few years' time when all engine manufacturers are on board with having more fuel again and having bigger tanks and all of that, then it's something we can go back to, the longer races and the races that we've always had in Formula One,” added the 26-year-old.
The fuel flow rate permitted by the rules will increase by 5 per cent next season, as part of a rebalancing of the split between combustion engine and electric power to 58-42 from the current 53-47.
It will increase again by 13 per cent in 2028, with the combustion engine-electric power split rising to 60-40.
The move is aimed at allowing for more flat-out driving and less energy management after widespread complaints about the racing having become more artificial.
Red Bull’s four-times champion Max Verstappen, a vocal critic of the sport’s current hybrid rules, said shortening the race distance would be worth it if it made the racing better.
“I mean I would run 50 per cent less if it would give me a nicer engine to drive,” joked the Dutchman.
“But, I don’t think it’s a big problem. If we have to shorten it a little bit for the fuel consumption but for overall a better racing experience then I think everyone will take it.” 
Ferrari rival and seven-times world champion Lewis Hamilton, however, opposed the move.
“This is supposed to be the sport which is the most physically and mentally demanding and there are some (races) that are so hot and you are on the edge,” said the 41-year-old.
“But that is where you want to see athletes, right on the edge of performance…”

Source: Reuters

DUBAI, Sept 23 : Microsoft is planning to invest more than $10 billion across the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Kuwait between now and 2030, including in cloud and AI infrastructure, a senior executive said on Wednesday.
The US tech giant is making digital resilience a key part of its strategy for the region as the Iran war rumbles on.
Microsoft's investment reflects both its "ongoing build-out of infrastructure and also the expansion of operations in the region," Vice Chair and President Brad Smith told Reuters.
Gulf countries are pouring billions into AI as they strive to become global hubs to help diversify their economies away from oil and gas, betting that land abundance and access to cheap energy will lure hyperscalers, including Microsoft.

However, challenges remain in areas including access to advanced chips and the uncertainty brought by the war, including attacks on data centres such as Amazon cloud unit AWS's facilities in Bahrain and the UAE.
"We're sustaining all the investments we planned to make before this conflict started, and we're in fact adding to them ... It's an aggressive spending schedule," said Smith.
He said Microsoft had supported local partners during the conflict, including with digital resilience assessments, even in the first week of the conflict, which began on February 28.
DIGITAL RESILIENCE
Microsoft is now working to help the Gulf countries in areas such as readiness and critical data protection as part of a digital resilience initiative.
It could not provide a breakdown of the planned investment by country or specific project, Smith said, citing factors including security.
While the UAE has been largely spared attacks since May, several other Gulf countries have continued to face threats.
Microsoft also plans to invest more than $400 million in subsea and terrestrial connectivity across the Middle East by 2030.
It is also strengthening its partnership with national AI companies, including Abu Dhabi's G42, in which Microsoft invested $1.5 billion for a minority stake in 2024, giving the US firm a board seat currently filled by Smith.
Microsoft is working with Saudi Arabia's Humain and Qatar's Qai "in selected areas that are priorities for them," he said, noting that it does not plan capital investments in the firms. 

Source: Reuters

items.title: ‘Not exactly where we want to be’: Investment strategist on Canada-U.S. relations
items.author: Jordan Fleguel
items.summary: As Prime Minister Mark Carney’s government continues to pursue economic partnerships with countries outside the U.S., the need for Canada to reach a new trade deal with its southern neighbour is only ...
items.body: As Prime Minister Mark Carney’s government continues to pursue economic partnerships with countries outside the U.S., the need for Canada to reach a new trade deal with its southern neighbour is only intensifying, an expert says. “Every new (Canadian) trade deal seems to be bringing a certain amount of ire out of the U.S.,” Pierre Ouimet, head investment strategist at UBS Canada, told BNN Bloomberg in an interview Wednesday. “We need to negotiate something solid with the U.S. at some point in time… this whole thing just creates an environment of uncertainty and that’s not really favourable when we’re trying to attract capital from everywhere in the world.” Ouimet’s comments came after Carney announced on Tuesday that Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi will be visiting Canada in December, when a new trade deal may be signed between Ottawa and New Delhi. “What India is looking for is energy, that’s the main thing, and they want a secure supply as well, so Canada is on the top of the list,” Ouimet said. “(It would be) another trade deal; what can I say, Mr. Carney has been pursuing trade deals left, right and centre and in the process, he keeps poking the bear, as we say.” Last week, Carney attended European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen’s annual State of the Union address in Strasbourg, France, when she announced her intention to “open the door” for Canada to become the European Union’s (EU) first associate member. U.S. President Donald Trump said such a move could be considered a “hostile act” and threatened to increase tariffs on the EU if a formal Canada-EU partnership is forged with “bad intentions.” Tariffs not a ‘major threat’ As Canadian and U.S. negotiators remain at odds over a new trade deal, tariffs and counter-tariffs continue to weigh on Canada’s economy, but Ouimet argued that they are not “necessarily a threat” in the long term. “I think most serious people agree that tariffs are not the way to go, unless it’s really specific in some industries with some obvious abuses, but overall, tariffs and the use of tariffs… I don’t think that’s a major threat,” he said. “We’re already in the mix of it; how bad can it get? Can it really get worse?” Still, Ouimet said a prolonged trade war with Canada’s largest and most important trading partner is not ideal for the country’s economy or its financial markets. “A trade war with the U.S.,” he said, “is not exactly where we want to be.”

OEIRAS, Portugal, Sept 23 : Cristiano Ronaldo walked into a packed room, claimed to be nervous, then did what he has done for more than two decades: taking centre stage, swatting away critics and insisting the final whistle is not yet in sight.
The 41-year-old Portugal captain, speaking on Wednesday at the Portugal Football Summit main stage before Thursday's UEFA Nations League match against Wales, said he still had plenty to offer his country as Jorge Jesus prepares for his first game as national team coach.
Jesus replaced Roberto Martinez after Portugal's disappointing World Cup campaign ended in the round of 16 against eventual champions Spain.
Ronaldo, now on 979 career goals — 833 for clubs and 146 for Portugal — is 21 short of the 1,000-goal landmark he has openly targeted. Asked whether winning the Nations League or reaching four figures mattered more, he grinned and chose both.

"One goal is to achieve both – reaching 1,000 goals and the national team trying to win this Nations League," Ronaldo said at the Portugal Football Summit at the Portuguese FA headquarters outside Lisbon.
"It's a new era with manager Jorge Jesus, whom we all know well; I just hope things go well for him."
Ronaldo said reaching 1,000 in Portugal colours would be "the icing on the cake".
"Scoring my 1,000th goal for the national team would be the culmination of something – a beautiful story," he said. "It wouldn't be the end of it, but it would be a beautiful story."
Ronaldo insisted, however, that he was not consumed by the chase.
"I've already admitted that I want to get there, and I will get there," he said. "An obsession? No ... The rest is about enjoying it, enjoying every day."
PRODUCTIVE TALKS
Ronaldo acknowledged he had considered his international future after Portugal's World Cup exit, but said talks with the Portuguese FA and Jesus convinced him to continue.
"They count on me. I still believe that I'm able to help the national team," he said. "The most important point is to be able, inside the pitch, to score goals and help the team to win games.
"If the manager doesn't count on me, I can leave today – no problem at all... When I feel that I'm not doing anything here, that I'm not contributing on the pitch, not scoring goals, creating a bad atmosphere, or that they don't want me here, I'll be the first to pack my bags."
Pressed on retirement, Ronaldo refused to draw a clear line under his career.
"I learnt something from my late 30s onwards, which is to live in the moment, don't think about tomorrow," he said.
"Is it possible? Yes. Highly likely? Yes. But will it happen? No, I don't know."
Ronaldo also bristled at criticism, saying media outlets had been trying to "kill" him for years.
"That's not going to happen under any circumstances – not even with a shotgun," he said. "And even so, I still manage to dodge the bullet."
Ronaldo may be 21 goals from four figures and perhaps closer to the exit than he cares to admit, but for now he remains exactly where he likes to be: in Portugal's shirt, in front of the cameras, and dodging bullets with a smile.

items.title: Governo abre discussão sobre futuro de concessões hidrelétricas, cita possíveis "travas" em leilões
items.author: Leticia Augusto
items.creator: Leticia Augusto
items.summary: O Ministério de Minas e Energia colocou em consulta pública uma proposta de diretrizes sobre o futuro de uma série de concessões de usinas hidrelétricas que vencem até 2032, citando possíveis "travas" em leilões para evitar concentração de mercado entre os grandes grupos hidrelétricos.
items.body:
O Ministério de Minas e Energia colocou em consulta pública uma proposta de diretrizes sobre o futuro de uma série de concessões de usinas hidrelétricas que vencem até 2032, citando possíveis "travas" em leilões para evitar concentração de mercado entre os grandes grupos hidrelétricos.
A discussão interessa a importantes companhias do setor que possuem portfólios hidrelétricos, como Axia (AXIA3.SA) , Copel (CPLE3.SA) e Engie (EGIE3.SA) .
Axia e Copel, que tiveram concessões hidrelétricas renovadas em seus processos de privatização, têm defendido que os próximos ativos vincendos sejam colocados para disputa em leilões, alegando que isso também [USN:S0N43801A TEXT:"maximizaria os ganhos ao governo"]. Já a Engie, com concessões vencendo nos próximos anos, quer a prorrogação de seus contratos.
No documento, o ministério não propõe um caminho único -- licitação ou prorrogação -- para os contratos vincendos, que envolvem mais de 15 gigawatts (GW) do parque hidrelétrico brasileiro.
Mas, no caso de eventuais leilões, diz que se cogita o estabelecimento de "travas ou limites máximos de aquisição dos ativos no leilão, calibrados pelo 'market share' resultante após os lances".
A ideia, segundo a nota técnica, seria evitar que companhias elétricas aumentem seus portfólios hidrelétricos a ponto de serem capazes de exercer influência relevante sobre os preços de energia no país.
Essas medidas seriam calibradas para que não reduzam a concorrência nos leilões, e também discutidas com os agentes do setor, órgãos de controle, regulador, operador, planejador, potenciais investidores, bem como os participantes do Sistema Brasileiro de Defesa da Concorrência (SBDC), diz a pasta.
Já no caso de prorrogações contratuais, a alternativa ficaria condicionada, por exemplo, à demonstração da prestação do "serviço adequado". Também não haveria antecipação do fim do prazo da outorga atual.
Tanto no caso de licitação quanto de prorrogação contratual, as empresas terão que pagar ao governo pelas novas outorgas hidrelétricas. O pagamento pelo valor da outorga ocorrerá 50% à vista, e o restante poderá ser pago em até cinco parcelas anuais, diretamente à Conta de Desenvolvimento Energético (CDE), visando a modicidade tarifária.
A previsão é de que as novas outorgas hidrelétricas terão prazo de vinte anos, podendo ainda ter duração inferior.
Ao todo, as regras devem alcançar 40 usinas hidrelétricas, que totalizam cerca de 15,4 GW de capacidade instalada, sendo 20 com concessões vencendo até 2029, e outras 20, no horizonte entre 2030 e 2032.
Além disso, outras 40 pequenas centrais hidrelétricas (PCHs), com 0,7 GW de capacidade instalada, têm contratos expirando no período.

items.title: US senators press for quick Chinese vehicle ban this week as Xi visits
items.author: David Shepardson
items.creator: David Shepardson
items.summary: US senators proposing bipartisan legislation to make permanent a ban on Chinese vehicles are aiming to win quick Senate approval this week, as President Donald Trump meets with China's President Xi Jinping, one of the bill's authors said on Wednesday.
items.body:
US senators proposing bipartisan legislation to make permanent a ban on Chinese vehicles are aiming to win quick Senate approval this week, as President Donald Trump meets with China's President Xi Jinping, one of the bill's authors said on Wednesday.
The effort, first reported by Reuters, is led by Democratic Senator Elissa Slotkin of Michigan and Republican Senator Bernie Moreno of Ohio. The bill has significant momentum and a House version now tops 100 cosponsors, while automakers and legislative aides hope to win passage this year.
Slotkin said she and Moreno aim to win unanimous Senate approval for it this week.
"Whether you are a Democrat or Republican, no one wants Chinese cars in America," she said at a Capitol Hill press conference, adding the measure's authors are trying to identify any opponents and address their concerns.
A couple of Republican senators have already raised some concerns, a congressional aide told Reuters, adding that it was not yet clear whether they will object.
A notice sent to offices of Democratic senators said Moreno intended to seek unanimous consent for the bill this week.
Trump is expected to meet Xi in Washington this week to address a wide range of trade issues. China has strongly opposed the US vehicle ban and efforts to make it permanent.
Earlier this month, Trump told Fox News he would accept Chinese car companies building cars in the United States, sparking alarm among automakers.
Slotkin said allowing this would mark "the beginning of the end of auto manufacturing in the United States."
INDUSTRY CONCERNS Last week, automakers, suppliers and dealers urged Trump "to maintain policies that keep the door firmly shut to Chinese automakers seeking to sell, import or manufacture vehicles inside the US"
A regulation imposed by former President Joe Biden's administration in early 2025 effectively banned all Chinese automakers from selling or building passenger vehicles in the US because they could send sensitive driver data to China. Washington also maintains more than 100% tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles.
The bill, which has 51 Senate supporters, would make the ban into law and prevent the White House from issuing waivers to Chinese vehicles to sell vehicles in the United States.
The auto industry letter came from six groups representing General Motors (GM.N) , Toyota (7203.T) Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) , Ford (F.N) Hyundai (005380.KS) Stellantis (STLAM.MI) Tesla (TSLA.O) and others.
They argue Chinese investment would not create new American jobs but "shift jobs away from manufacturers that have made generational investments in the US and toward companies owned and operated by the Chinese government."
Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, cellular connectivity and some satellite communications technologies are covered under the rules based on national security concerns linked to the ability of vehicles to collect sensitive data on American owners.

items.title: 円が158円台前半に下落－強い指標でドル全面高、利上げ継続との見方
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 23日のニューヨーク外国為替市場で、ドルが主要通貨に対して全面高となり、円は対ドルで9月3日以来の安値をつけた。米総合購買担当者指数（PMI）が2021年以来およそ5年ぶりの高水準となり、連邦準備制度（FRB）が利上げを継続するとの見方が強まった。

円は一時、0.6%安の1ドル＝158円40銭まで売られ、200日移動平均線の158円45銭に接近した。先週18日に、日本銀行がレートチェックを実施したとの報道が伝わる前につけていた158円05銭の安値水準を超えて円安・ドル高が進んだ。

一方、ブルームバーグ・ドル・スポット指数は0.6%上昇し、7月30日以来の高水準を付けた。今月に入ってからは1.4%上昇している。

この日は金利が急上昇した。強いPMI統計に加え、原油高や低調な入札を受けて国債売りが加速。大半の年限で利回りが約20年ぶりの高水準に上昇した。

バンク・オブ・アメリカ（BofA）の為替ストラテジスト、アレックス・コーエン氏は「ファンダメンタルズは一段のドル高を示唆している」と指摘。「PMIの上振れで米経済の底堅さが改めて意識された。夏場に見られた米経済指標の弱含み傾向は後退し、FRBの利上げ観測は他国・地域よりも根強い」と述べた。

ドルを巡るセンチメントは改善が続いており、先高観が根強い。FRBが3年ぶりの利上げに踏み切った後も、当局者はインフレに対するタカ派姿勢を維持している。原油高と底堅い経済指標を背景に、短期金融市場は年内に少なくとも0.25ポイントの追加利上げを織り込んだ。10月の利上げ確率は50%を上回っている。

INGのストラテジスト、フランチェスコ・ペソレ氏は「相場を支配しているのはFRBだ。FRB高官のタカ派発言だけでも、ドル需要を維持するには十分だ」と指摘した。

過去10年の傾向では、9月最終週はドルが最も上昇しやすい。ブルームバーグの集計によると、この期間の週間騰落率（中央値）は、1年を通じて最も高かった。最終週に当たる21日から始まる今週も、ドルはこれまで0.8%上昇しており、今年も過去と同じ傾向をたどっている。

[プレトリア　２３日　ロイター] - 南アフリカ準備銀行（ＳＡＲＢ、中央銀行）は２３日の金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）で、政策金利のレポ金利を２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き上げ、７．２５％にすることを全会一致で決定した。インフレ率を中銀目標である３％に抑えることを目指していると述べた。

南ア中銀は、インフレ目標３％の上下１％ポイントを許容範囲としている。８月の南ア消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前年同月４．４％上昇と、７月の４．３％から伸びが加速した。

ロイターがまとめた調査でエコノミストの大半が２５ｂｐの利上げを予想していた。７月に開かれた前回の会合以降、イラン情勢の緊迫化に伴い原油価格が再び上昇し、世界経済の見通しも悪化している。
