items.title: Four US Republicans call for Trump to release Taiwan security funds
items.author: Patricia Zengerle
items.creator: Patricia Zengerle
items.summary: Four of US President Donald Trump's fellow Republicans called on his administration on Wednesday to release more than $15 billion in stalled national security assistance for Taiwan, as he prepared to welcome Chinese President Xi Jinping for a three-day visit to Washington.
items.body:
Four of US President Donald Trump's fellow Republicans called on his administration on Wednesday to release more than $15 billion in stalled national security assistance for Taiwan, as he prepared to welcome Chinese President Xi Jinping for a [USN:L6N45E02J TEXT:"three-day visit"] to Washington.
US Senators Mitch McConnell of Kentucky, the former Senate majority leader, John Cornyn of Texas, Lisa Murkowski of Alaska and Thom Tillis of North Carolina wrote to Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth expressing concern about the funds.
The letter cites the State Department's failure to move ahead with $300 million in foreign military financing Congress appropriated for Taiwan, the Defense Department's failure to obligate $1 billion and the administration's decision to withhold approval for a $14 billion package of foreign military sales to the island.
"We are concerned by President Trump's description of Taiwan as 'a very good negotiating chip' in engagements with Xi Jinping and the Chinese Communist Party," the letter said.
"It is difficult to imagine how the United States might credibly project influence deterrence in the Indo-Pacific if the price of keeping up diplomatic appearances is denying our partners key deterrent capabilities," the letter said.
The State and Defense departments did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the letter.
Xi [USN:L4N45D00S TEXT:"is expected"] to press Trump to halt Taiwan arms sales altogether under a 1982 joint statement during his visit to Washington, sources briefed on the matter told Reuters.
China regularly describes the issue of Taiwan, which Beijing views as its own territory, as its most sensitive and important diplomatic issue, and has repeatedly called for arms sales to stop.
The Trump administration in December approved an $11 billion arms package to Taiwan, the largest ever. However, a second package, worth some $14 billion, has been on hold for months.
After a [USN:P8N3ZT02P TEXT:"May summit in Beijing"] with Xi, Trump said he was holding it in abeyance and described it as a "very good negotiating chip."
Trump's fellow Republicans in Congress rarely question his administration's actions publicly. Three of the senators who signed Wednesday's letter — McConnell, Cornyn and Tillis — are leaving the Senate at the end of this year, with only Murkowski remaining.

FAST

Sept 22 - A rise in Japanese bond yields is creating a "reverse carry" opportunity for overseas investors as Bank of Japan interest-rate hikes make the traditional yen-funded carry trade less compelling, Rong Ren Goh, fixed income portfolio manager at Eastspring Investments, said on Wednesday.
Japanese asset prices have swung sharply since the US Federal Reserve and BOJ raised rates within two days of each other last week, with a decades-long era of ultra-cheap yen funding potentially giving way to a new dynamic where Japan's own bonds become the more attractive trade.
Buying ultra-long Japanese government bonds and hedging yen exposure back into dollars or another developed-market currency could potentially give investors higher yields versus comparable bonds in their home markets, Goh told the Reuters Global Markets Forum.
"The 30-year Japanese government bond above 4 per cent, when swapped in any developed-market currency in the world, including the dollar, gives you an FX-hedged yield 100 to 200 basis points higher than the base currency equivalent," he said.

Goh said the traditional yen-funded carry trade - in which investors borrow cheaply in the Japanese currency to buy higher-yielding foreign assets - is no longer a "no-brainer", as markets expect Japan's policy rate to eventually reach around 2 per cent from 1.25 per cent currently.
He expects the reverse carry trade to gain broader appeal as investors become more confident of a stabilisation in Japanese bond prices following a selloff that started in 2022.
Positioning data showed the net yen long position in the week to September 15 jumped to its highest since July 2025.
A sharp move lower for the yen after Friday's 25-bp BOJ rate hike that came with two dissents, which investors interpreted as a dovish tilt at the Japanese central bank, was contained by a report that authorities conducted rate checks in the currency market.
The yen is currently up 1.2 per cent versus the dollar month-to-date.
Pointing to Japan's steepening yield curve - where the gap between 2- and 30-year JGB yields is more than 200 bps compared with an average of around 80 bps in other core developed markets where curves are flattening - Goh said buying dollar bonds no longer offered "any compelling carry play", even if the differential between U.S. and Japanese interest rates remained wide.
Goh said Eastspring - which manages $291 billion in assets - is adding shorter-dated dollar-denominated bonds, while favouring the ultra-long end of the Japanese curve where the firm is gradually building exposure through high-quality corporate and Samurai bonds as it seeks "additional credit spread over and above JGBs to enhance carry further".
Samurai bonds are yen-denominated debt issued by foreign governments or companies.
Eastspring began 2026 with a relatively "underweight" position on the yen due to uncertainty over Japan's fiscal and monetary policies, but moved to a more neutral stance around August as currency intervention risk became more meaningful, Goh said.

items.title: イラン、外交再開へ米に条件提示　ホルムズ海峡航路や制裁停止など
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [国連／ドバイ ２３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[国連／ドバイ ２３日 ロイター] - イラン外務省の報道官は２３日、米国に対し外交再開の条件を伝えたと明らかにした。

報道官によると、イランは２２日、国連総会の合間に仲介役のカタールを通じ、２時間にわたり米国とメッセージを交換し、条件を提示した。条件には、ホルムズ海峡の沿岸国であるイランとオマーンが合意した同海峡の安全航路の受け入れ、経済「テロ」や海上封鎖を含む米国による対イラン措置の停止、凍結資産の解除、あらゆる戦線での戦闘終結が含まれるという。

これに先立ち、イラン高官は、敵対行為の終結に向けたイランの提案に対する米国の対応を精査していると明らかにした。また、両国の立場には依然多くの隔たりがあるものの、外交交渉は続いていると述べた。同高官によると、２２日の米・イラン間接協議では、ホルムズ海峡の再開や米国による対イラン海上封鎖の解除などが議題となった。

items.title: US open to extending China trade truce, or bigger deal, Bessent says after meeting with He
items.author: Andrea Shalal
items.creator: Andrea Shalal
items.summary: The United States is open to extending the US-China trade truce that expires on November 10 or looking at a more expansive trade deal, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Wednesday following his second meeting with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng to prepare for a summit between the two countries' leaders.
items.body:
The United States is open to extending the US-China trade truce that expires on November 10 or looking at a more expansive trade deal, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Wednesday following his second meeting with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng to prepare for [USN:L6N45E02J TEXT:"a summit"] between the two countries' leaders.
Bessent said Beijing raised the issue of a potentially bigger US-China trade deal during talks on Sunday, but gave no details of its potential scope. US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are expected to continue the talks at the White House on Thursday.
"The Chinese on Sunday came up with the idea of a bigger deal, and given that this could be a historic year where the leaders meet up to four times -- this being the second meeting, in Shenzhen and then in Miami -- we're open to the idea of just continuing the Busan arrangement or examining the bigger deal," Bessent told reporters. "We're fine with both, and we're going to do what's best for the American people."
In a post on X, Bessent called the discussions substantive and said Treasury was focused on securing "meaningful commitments that protect American workers, farmers and businesses while advancing U.S. economic and national security interests."
“Both sides remain actively engaged, and the talks are making progress on a range of important issues,” said a source familiar with the meetings, describing them as productive and constructive.
Bessent earlier said he was meeting with He at World Bank headquarters in Washington to clear up some "unfinished business" ahead of the Trump-Xi summit, adding that the Trump administration wanted strategic stability based on "reciprocity and fairness."
His comments afterwards were the strongest signal yet that an extension of the trade truce struck last year in Busan, South Korea, was on the agenda for the Trump-Xi summit.
Bessent, He and US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer [USN:L1N45B04Y TEXT:"met in New York on Sunday"] in an effort to tee up potential trade and artificial intelligence agreements for the two leaders to consider. Bessent has characterized those talks as successful, saying both sides had agreed to launch a communications "hotline" for notifying each other about AI safety incidents.
China's response to the AI hotline plan was unclear, with state news agency Xinhua acknowledging only that the two sides discussed AI.
US-China analysts say expectations on AI cooperation are low due to a lack of mutual trust on the technology and because neither side has expressed serious interest in slowing down development. In fact, Trump has said the opposite, that he would not "stifle" AI growth and would maintain the US lead over China in what he now calls "super intelligence."
The Bessent-Greer-He meeting on Sunday left unresolved the fate of the nearly year-long trade truce between Washington and Beijing, which expires on November 10. The truce dramatically lowered bilateral tariff rates that had escalated to triple digits after tit-for-tat retaliation over Trump's tariff hikes last year. China also had agreed to restore the flow of rare earth magnets and other critical minerals that it had severely restricted.
Greer told Bloomberg TV on Monday that discussions about extending the trade truce would continue because there was time.
"But my expectation is we'll continue talking and I think both sides want it," he said of a trade truce extension.
Greer added that the US needed to keep pressure on China to ensure compliance on its critical minerals agreements. US officials last week told reporters that the delivery of rare earths by China "has not been up to par."
On Sunday, the two sides discussed other topics that had been previously discussed by Trump and Xi at a May meeting in Beijing, including lowering mutual tariffs on some non-strategic goods and Chinese purchases of Boeing aircraft and agricultural goods.
Greer had said the two sides agreed to "operationalize" a process agreed in May for each side to identify potential tariff cuts on non-strategic goods, called the "Board of Trade." He said these could include Chinese exports such as "consumer goods, low-tech items," while US exports for this treatment could include energy, agricultural goods and medical devices.

FAST

NEW YORK, Sept 23 : The US dollar rallied to its highest level in nearly two months on Wednesday as investors' expectations of a near-term Federal Reserve rate hike grew, while oil prices jumped after Iran cast doubt on progress in peace talks.
Since the central bank's rate hike of 25 basis points last week to the 3.75 per cent-4.00 per cent range, several Federal Reserve officials have flagged the possibility of more rate increases if inflation does not cool.
On Wednesday, Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr said the US central bank took an important step last week to "recalibrate" short-term borrowing costs to bring down inflation, and will likely need to deliver further interest rate hikes.
"It's a rate story right now," said Elias Haddad, global head of markets strategy at Brown Brothers Harriman in London.

"What's driving the dollar higher is a follow through from the hawkish Fed hike that we got last week and that's just given the dollar some renewed momentum. This week there hasn't been much data, or policy relevant data, but what was interesting is the comments from Fed officials, they're basically all toeing the same line that more tightening is in the pipeline."
The dollar extended gains after S&P Global said its flash US Composite PMI Output Index, which tracks the manufacturing and services sectors, increased to 58.4 this month, its highest since July 2021, after a 56.0 reading in August, powered by a surge in new orders, though strong demand strained supply chains and pushed prices higher.
The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies, rose 0.51 per cent to 101.06 after hitting 101.23, its highest since July 29.
Expectations the Fed will hike rates by at least 25 basis points at its October meeting climbed after the data and were last at about 70 per cent, according to LSEG data, up from roughly 53 per cent before the release.
MIDDLE EAST TENSIONS LIFT OIL
Further fueling gains in the greenback was a rise in oil prices, after Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, said in an interview with state TV that as long as Iran's conditions are not met, the Strait of Hormuz would not be reopened and there would be no negotiations.
In addition, a senior Iranian official told Reuters that Iran and the United States remain far apart on how to end their war but diplomacy must continue, after Iran's president told the UN General Assembly that Tehran would never surrender to US pressure.
Hopes that diplomacy at the UN General Assembly could lead to a resolution to the seven-month-long Iran war had helped push oil prices lower since reaching a four-month high in mid-September, but have since reversed course this week.
Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee said the central bank needs to "be careful" and may need to treat the current energy shock as a source of persistent inflation rather than expect it to dissipate on its own.
EURO WEAKENS, YEN UNDER PRESSURE
The euro was down 0.51 per cent at $1.1389 and on pace for its third straight daily decline and biggest drop in a week. Earlier S&P Global Flash Euro Zone Composite PMI Output Index data showed the region's economy is showing unexpected signs of health even as conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine drive up energy costs for firms and households.
Investors are also waiting for a meeting between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, with the superpowers at odds over trade, technology and the Iran war.
The dollar strengthened 0.17 per cent to 6.71 versus the offshore Chinese yuan.
The Japanese yen weakened 0.52 per cent against the greenback to 158.19 per dollar as traders gird for any signs of intervention after the Bank of Japan's rate hike to a 31-year high last week fell short of reassuring investors that more increases may be on the way.
Japanese markets are closed for a holiday and this period of lower liquidity makes it more likely that authorities intervene, according to analysts.

items.title: 米ロ外相が会談、ルビオ氏「双方が限定停戦に関心」　ロシア慎重姿勢
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tom Balmforth　Antoni Slodkowski　Simon Lewis

[ニューヨーク／モスクワ／国連　２３日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Tom Balmforth　Antoni Slodkowski　Simon Lewis

[ニューヨーク／モスクワ／国連　２３日　ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は２３日、ロシアのラブロフ外相と国連総会が開かれているニューヨークで会談した。会談後、ロシアとウクライナの双方が穀物関連施設やエネルギー関連施設を対象とする限定的な停戦に関心を示していると述べたほか、ロシアのプーチン大統領が２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）首脳会議への招待を受け入れることを期待するとし、プーチン氏が出席すればトランプ米大統領と会談する機会になるとの認識を示した。 

ウクライナは、ロシアが今冬も発電施設や暖房施設を標的にする可能性を懸念しており、エネルギーインフラへの攻撃停止や黒海の海上輸送に関する安全保障を求めている。ルビオ氏はラブロフ氏との会談後に記者団に対し「ロシアとウクライナの双方が穀物とエネルギーを巡る限定的な停戦に関心を示している」と述べた。ただ「実現は容易ではない」とも指摘。エネルギー関連施設への攻撃が双方の戦術上の中核になっていることで停戦実現が難しくなっているとの認識を示した。

ロシアはエネルギー施設などに限定した停戦などを巡る取り決めに応じる用意があるとの考えを公に示しておらず、ルビオ氏の発言がラブロフ氏との会談で何らかの進展があったことを意味するのか、現時点では明らかになっていない。

＜ラブロフ氏、「特別軍事作戦」目標達成継続と表明＞

ロシア外務省もラブロフ氏がルビオ氏と会談したと発表。ウクライナと中東の情勢や、米ロ関係の改善など幅広い課題について「詳細な意見交換」を行ったとした。

また、ラブロフ氏はウクライナと「欧州の支援国」との連携のほか、ウクライナによる国境を越えた攻撃について言及。「ウクライナによる破壊的な行動や民間人、国境を越えるインフラ施設への意図的な攻撃について言及した」とし、こうした攻撃が「世界のエネルギー市場の不安定化につながっている」と伝えた。

同時に、ロシアはウクライナでの「特別軍事作戦」の目標達成に引き続き取り組む姿勢を表明。これには、ロシアがウクライナ全面侵攻の「根本的な原因」と位置付ける問題を考慮した形での解決も含まれるという。

ラブロフ氏はこのほか、米ロ関係の「早期改善」の必要性を強調し、将来的な経済協力拡大の可能性にも言及。「そのためには『懸案事項』の解消と両国の在外公館の正常な運営回復に向けた率直な対話が必要だ」とし、「事実上没収された米国内のロシア資産」の返還が必要になるとの認識を示した。

ラブロフ氏はこの日、ロシア・ウクライナ戦争を討議する国連安全保障理事会の会合に出席。会合で行った演説で、「欧州は停戦による時間稼ぎを望んでいるに過ぎない。目的はウクライナに武器供与を続けることにある」と述べ、ロシアには一時停戦を受け入れる考えがない可能性を示唆した。

＜ゼレンスキー氏、黒海海上停戦案を支持＞

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領はこの日、国連総会に合わせて開催された「クリミア・プラットフォーム」首脳会合で行った演説で、エジプト、インド、トルコが提案した黒海の海上停戦案を受け入れる用意があると表明。対応はロシア次第になるとの認識を示した。

ゼレンスキー氏によると、会合でエジプト、インド、トルコが黒海での商船の安全な航行を回復するための選択肢を提示。「ロシアの回答を待っている」とし、「ロシアも緊張緩和に向けた真剣な措置を取れば、ウクライナは黒海の安全な航行と食料安全保障の確保に向けて準備ができている。どこかから始めなければならない」と語った。

黒海ではロシアとウクライナの双方による船舶や港湾インフラへの激しい攻撃を受け、貨物輸送がほぼ停止している。

items.title: Monedas caen con fuerza por avance del dólar ante expectativas nuevas alzas tasas Fed
items.author: Manuel Farías
items.creator: Manuel Farías
items.summary: Las principales monedas de América Latina cayeron con fuerza el miércoles, presionadas por el avance del dólar a nivel global, en medio de un alza de los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense ante datos que reafirmaron las expectativas de alzas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal.
items.body:
Las principales monedas de América Latina cayeron con fuerza el miércoles, presionadas por el avance del dólar a nivel global, en medio de un alza de los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense ante datos que reafirmaron las expectativas de alzas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal.
* La actividad empresarial estadounidense alcanzó en septiembre un máximo de más de cinco años, impulsada por un aumento de los nuevos pedidos, aunque la fuerte demanda ejerció presión sobre las cadenas de suministro y provocó un alza de los precios.
* El gobernador de la Reserva Federal Michael Barr dijo el miércoles que el banco central estadounidense dio un paso importante la semana pasada para "recalibrar" los costos de financiación a corto plazo con el fin de reducir la inflación, y que probablemente tendrá que aplicar nuevas alzas de las tasas de interés.
* El dólar repuntó a máximos de casi dos meses en la sesión, ya que los inversores aumentaron sus expectativas de alzas de tasas a corto plazo por parte de la Reserva Federal, mientras que los precios del petróleo escalaron después de que unas declaraciones de Irán pusieron en duda los avances en las negociaciones de paz.
* El presidente iraní, Masoud Pezeshkian, prometió no rendirse nunca, un día después de que el mandatario estadounidense, Donald Trump, advirtiera que podría "aniquilar" a Irán.
* El peso colombiano lideró las bajas al caer un 2,28%, a 3.276 unidades por dólar, su mayor descenso intradía en siete semanas y en su octava sesión de pérdidas.
* En la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) repuntó un 0,92% a 2.612,48 puntos.
* El peso mexicano bajaba por la tarde un 1,36%, a 17,5065 unidades por dólar, a la espera además de la decisión sobre tasas de Banxico; en tanto que el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, cedía hacia el cierre un 0,37%, a 64.216,68 puntos.
* "El peso se deprecia en la antesala de la decisión de política monetaria del Banco de México de mañana jueves 24 de septiembre, para la que se espera que mantenga la tasa de interés sin cambios en 6,50%", dijo Banco Base en un reporte.
* "En contraste, el mercado anticipa tres incrementos adicionales de 25 puntos base en la tasa de interés de la Reserva Federal hacia junio del 2027 y dos incrementos adicionales por parte del Banco de Japón", agregó.
* El real brasileño retrocedió un 1,27% a 5,1689 unidades por dólar la venta, mientras que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) se contagió del mal humor externo y perdió preliminarmente un 0,79%, a 185.940 puntos.
* El peso chileno , cayó un 1,51%, a 962,20/962,50 unidades por dólar y anotó su menor valor de cierre en casi un año, ante el avance global de la divisa estadounidense y un retroceso en los precios del cobre, la mayor exportación del país. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , avanzó un ligero 0,2%, a 11.449,63 puntos.
* "El dólar sigue de cerca la tensión en medio oriente y el precio del petróleo. El dólar superó los 960 con el petróleo subiendo +3% y el cobre cayendo 1%. Si bien eso tiene lógica, la magnitud de la subida del CLP (tipo de cambio) es mayor que la de otros países como México o Brasil... lo que tiene bastante sorprendido a buena parte del mercado local", dijo Patricio Eskenazi, director de Inversiones de Conpat Global.
* El peso mayorista argentino se depreció un 0,13% a 1.516,5 unidades por dólar, en un mercado donde el banco central (BCRA) interviene diariamente para sumar reservas a sus arcas, en base a un acuerdo con el FMI. La entidad monetaria compró 6 millones de dólares de la plaza cambiaria.
* El índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires, en tanto, cayó un 0,94%.
* "El mercado descuenta que habrá estabilidad total del tipo de cambio real hasta mediados del año que viene, según surge de la comparación entre las curvas CER (inflación) y 'dollar linked' (tipo de cambio)", reportó el agente de liquidación y compensación Facimex.
* El Estimador Mensual de la Actividad Económica (EMAE) de Argentina habría mejorado un 1,8% interanual en julio, reflejando una desaceleración respecto al 2,7% de junio, según la mediana de un sondeo de Reuters.
* La moneda peruana, el sol , se depreció un 0,8% a 3,3890/3,3930 unidades por dólar. En tanto que la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) perdió un 1,6% a 1.568 puntos.

Sept 23 : OVHcloud CEO Octave Klaba on Tuesday estimated operators of Europe's proposed AI gigafactories would need annual sales of 300 million euros to 400 million euros just to break even on facilities built around fast-depreciating graphics chips. 
Klaba said a proposed 200-million-euro public commitment to buy AI services over five years was too small to underpin the scale of private investment required and said focus on national markets prevented OVHcloud from joining existing French consortia. 
The EuroHPC program is seeking industry consortia to build and operate up to seven AI gigafactories: large computing facilities for training, fine-tuning and running AI models.
"Any national strategy is doomed to failure: there are simply not enough customers to make investments of this size profitable. In our view, national demand is too weak and we must operate on a European scale," he said.

Klaba said the public sector would buy 40 million euros of computing services a year, while an operator would spend at least 600 million euros for chips alone. "The numbers don't add up," he said. 
He estimated a gigafactory would need 300 million euros to 400 million euros in annual revenue to break even, making the public order worth only 10 per cent-15 per cent of required turnover.

items.title: Scientists map gene activity in brain's prefrontal cortex
items.author: Will Dunham
items.creator: Will Dunham
items.summary: Scientists have created a detailed map of gene activity within a crucial part of the brain called the prefrontal cortex, gaining insight into normal development and major brain disorders such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease and schizophrenia.
items.body:
Scientists have created a detailed map of gene activity within a crucial part of the [USN:L1N3WF0WU TEXT:"brain"] called the prefrontal cortex, gaining insight into normal development and major brain disorders such as [USN:L1N3XG1B9 TEXT:"Alzheimer's disease"], Parkinson's disease and schizophrenia.
In nine separate studies, the researchers examined changes in individual types of brain cells that occur over time and made progress toward deciphering molecular processes that underlie some of the most devastating brain disorders, a step toward possible new treatments.
The prefrontal cortex is the front part of the brain's outer layer, located behind the forehead. It helps a person plan, make decisions, regulate emotions and adapt behavior. It also is sensitive to age-related decline, and its functions are affected in many psychiatric and neurodegenerative disorders.
Gene activity was examined in the nuclei of more than 6.3 million brain cells — neurons, immune cells, cells associated with blood vessels and support cells that help maintain brain function — from 1,494 deceased donors, ranging in age from infancy to 108 years old, and with various genetic ancestries.
The donors included people with no diagnosed brain disorder as well as people diagnosed with conditions such as Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, Lewy body dementia, vascular dementia, schizophrenia and bipolar disorder.
The research identified patterns shared across some of the diseases as well as some specific to individual disorders.
"Together, these studies help explain where disease-related changes occur and which biological processes deserve closer investigation," said Dr. Panos Roussos, director of the Center for Disease Neurogenomics at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai in New York City and a leader of the research published on Wednesday in Nature and other journals.
"A useful treatment needs to influence the right biological process in the right cells. This map helps narrow that search. It can identify vulnerable cell populations, reveal processes associated with preserved brain function and help researchers decide which potential treatment targets to test," Roussos said.
The work was conducted as part of the PsychAD research consortium, with support from the National Institute on Aging, part of the US government's National Institutes of Health.
STRONG SIMILARITIES Alzheimer's, Lewy body disease, vascular dementia and Parkinson's showed particularly strong similarities in gene activity involved in nerve-cell development, neuronal communication and blood-vessel biology. The researchers also identified pathways shared in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's in microglia, the brain's resident immune cells.
Comparing brain samples from donors of different ages, the researchers found extensive molecular changes during development until adulthood, relative stability through much of adulthood and then renewed changes later in life, particularly in immune and support cells.
"This provides a reference for distinguishing typical aging from disease-associated changes," Roussos said.
The researchers identified approximately age 24 as a transition point after which the bulk of most cell types in this region become more stable.
"It does not mean the brain suddenly finishes developing on someone's 24th birthday, or that decline begins at that age. Other aspects of brain biology continue to change throughout life," Roussos said.
The researchers found cellular patterns associated with differences in cognition and with depression accompanying Alzheimer's. For instance, people who retained cognitive function despite experiencing substantial Alzheimer's pathology showed differences in energy-related processes in brain cells.
"These provide clues to possible protective mechanisms that need further testing," Roussos said.
INHERITED GENETIC RISK The researchers connected inherited genetic risk of disorders to particular genes and cell types, and mapped genetic influences on the activity of more than 14,000 genes.
They also reconstructed daily patterns of gene activity using brain samples from people who died at different times of day. In younger and middle-aged adults, daily clock genes showed coordinated patterns in neurons. In older adults, those patterns were weaker and less synchronized.
"This suggests that aging changes how daily biological rhythms are organized within the brain. Whether restoring those rhythms could improve brain health is an important question for future research," Roussos said.
The researchers also built molecular profiles for individual donors who had Alzheimer's, and identified differences in gene regulation and predicted interactions between cell types among individuals.
"This helps explain biological variation among people with the same diagnosis, and provides a foundation for investigating more individualized treatment strategies," Roussos said.

items.title: 米総合ＰＭＩ、9月は5年ぶり高水準　新規受注急増も供給網圧迫
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが２３日発表した９月の米総合購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）速報値は５８．４と、前月の５６．０から上昇し、２０２１年７月以来の高水準となった。新規受注の急増が押し上げ要因となった。一方で、堅調な需要がサプライチェーン（供給網）を圧迫し、物価上昇につながっている実態も浮き彫りとなった。

指数はサービス業、製造業ともに上昇した。ＰＭＩは５０が景況拡大・縮小の分岐点。Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルは、今回の結果について年率換算で約５％の経済成長率と整合的との見方を示した。同時に、未処理の受注残高やサプライチェーンの遅延が急増しているとし、「操業能力の不足を示しており、それが価格上昇につながっている」と指摘した。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスのチーフビジネスエコノミスト、クリス・ウィリアムソン氏は「製造業とサービス業の両方で活況を呈している」と指摘。その上で、「この成長には、新型コロナのパンデミック（世界的大流行）を除けば、調査開始以来約２０年で最も深刻なサプライチェーンのボトルネックが伴っている」と述べた。

新規受注指数は５８．２と、８月の５５．２から上昇し、２２年３月以来の高水準を記録した。サービス業、製造業の双方で上昇した。設備稼働率や将来の事業成長を示す重要な指標である受注残も２２年５月以来の高水準に達した。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルによると、各企業は受注残の増加に対応するため採用を拡大しているものの、適切な人材の確保に苦慮しているとの報告が増えている。

ウィリアムソン氏は「未完了受注の積み上がりは、今後数カ月間の生産高と生産能力の一段の拡大につながる可能性を示している。一方で、企業の価格決定力が高まっていることも示しており、インフレ見通しにとっては懸念材料だ」と述べた。

投入物価指数は６６．４と、前月の５９．９から急上昇し、２２年１０月以来の高水準となった。支払価格指数も上昇し、とりわけサービス部門での上昇が目立った。

FAST

DHAKA, Sept 23 : Bangladesh will buy a further 11 aircraft from Boeing, officials said on Wednesday, expanding national carrier Biman Bangladesh Airlines' planned orders to 25 jets as Dhaka seeks closer trade ties with the United States amid concerns over tariffs on its exports.
The agreement, scheduled to be signed in New York on Wednesday, is part of Bangladesh's efforts to boost imports from the United States, ease pressure from a roughly $6 billion trade imbalance and reduce the risk of tariff increases that could hurt its export-driven economy, particularly the garment sector.
The US Ambassador to Bangladesh, Brent Christensen, confirmed the Boeing purchase in a Facebook post, calling it another "win-win" for US-Bangladesh relations.
Biman is renewing its fleet, aiming to expand capacity and improve connectivity.

European rival Airbus remains in contention, with a government-appointed technical committee reviewing a proposal to acquire 10 aircraft.
Details of the additional Boeing order are expected to be disclosed after the signing ceremony.

items.title: Wall Street cierra en baja ante aumento precios del petróleo y de rendimiento bonos Tesoro
items.author: Noel Randewich
items.creator: Noel Randewich
items.summary: Wall Street cerró a la baja el miércoles, lastrado por Alphabet y Amazon, ya que los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro avanzaron y el presidente de Irán afirmó que Teherán nunca cedería ante la presión de Estados Unidos.
items.body:
Wall Street cerró a la baja el miércoles, lastrado por Alphabet y Amazon, ya que los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro avanzaron y el presidente de Irán afirmó que Teherán nunca cedería ante la presión de Estados Unidos.
* Los precios del petróleo escalaron casi un 4% y el índice del sector energético del S&P 500 (.SPNY) repuntó tras el discurso en la ONU del presidente iraní, Masoud Pezeshkian, un día después de que el mandatario estadounidense, Donald Trump, advirtiera que podría "aniquilar" a Irán.
* Una encuesta reveló que la actividad empresarial en Estados Unidos se aceleró en septiembre hasta su nivel más alto en más de cinco años, lo que impulsó a los rendimientos de los bonos gubernamentales y aumentó las expectativas de que la Reserva Federal suba las tasas de interés en su reunión de octubre.
* Los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro a dos años alcanzaron su nivel más alto desde 2024, mientras que los de la deuda a 10 años tocaron su máximo desde 2007.
* "El mercado de valores quiere una resolución al conflicto (en Oriente Medio) y, si no la conseguimos, tendremos tasas más altas durante más tiempo, lo que seguirá pesando sobre el mercado de renta variable", señaló Lauren Cassidy, directora de inversiones de Founders 100 ETF en Dallas.
* Meta Platforms (META.O) extendió sus ganancias de esta semana tras la buena acogida de su asistente de IA "Muse". Según analistas, este podría beneficiar a las firmas de infraestructura tecnológica, al tiempo que desafía a bancos, plataformas de comercio electrónico y otros negocios orientados al consumidor.
* Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , empresa matriz de Google, cayó, al igual que Amazon (AMZN.O) , que ha bloqueado el uso de Muse en su plataforma de compras.
* El índice de semiconductores PHLX (.SOX) retrocedió, con Nvidia (NVDA.O) perdiendo terreno.
* Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) perdió 57,74 puntos, o un 0,74%, a 7.706,39 puntos; el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) cedió 308,24 puntos, o un 1,10%, a 26.943,61 unidades; y el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) cayó 340,39 puntos, o un 0,66%, a 51.523,30 unidades.
* Los mercados también analizaron los comentarios del gobernador de la Fed Michael Barr, quien señaló que probablemente el banco central deba aplicar nuevas subidas de tasas de interés, dado que la inflación se mantiene por sobre el objetivo del 2%.

items.title: Petrobras já garantiu importações de diesel de 650 mi litros em outubro
items.author: Marta Nogueira
items.creator: Marta Nogueira
items.summary: A Petrobras já garantiu as compras externas de diesel necessárias para outubro, quando sazonalmente há um pico de consumo de diesel no Brasil, enquanto não vê grandes volumes necessários de compras externas para novembro, afirmou a diretora de Logística, Comercialização e Mercados, Angélica Laureano.
items.body:
A Petrobras (PETR3.SA) já garantiu as compras externas de diesel necessárias para outubro, quando sazonalmente há um pico de consumo de diesel no Brasil, enquanto não vê grandes volumes necessários de compras externas para novembro, afirmou a diretora de Logística, Comercialização e Mercados, Angélica Laureano.
A afirmação vem após executivos do setor de distribuição e importação terem afirmado mais cedo neste mês que havia preocupações com restrições localizadas de oferta no país. [USN:L6N4580W6 TEXT:"Na ocasião"], a defasagem em relação aos valores praticados pela Petrobras no Brasil havia subido para níveis recordes com uma nova escalada de preços do produto no exterior.
Também nesta quarta-feira, o presidente da Vibra Energia (VBBR3.SA) , Ernesto Pousada, afirmou que a maior distribuidora do país está preparada para ampliar as importações de diesel se houver necessidade, mesmo no atual cenário, em que o combustível no mercado internacional está entre R$2 e R$3 por litro mais caro que no Brasil.
A Petrobras, principal supridora de diesel no Brasil, prevê importar 650 milhões de litros de diesel no próximo mês. Por volta de outubro, o Brasil costuma passar por seu período de maior demanda de diesel, devido ao plantio da safra verão, que coincide também com o transporte do milho recém-colhido.
"As compras para outubro já estão realizadas. Em novembro ainda não sabemos se vamos ter demanda adicional, porque nós temos uma produção que atende bastante à nossa demanda", disse Laureano, após participar de uma mesa de discussões no congresso de petróleo e gás ROG.e.
"Mas não é previsto que em novembro venhamos a importar um volume grande de diesel, porque já é um momento depois da safra."
O volume que a Petrobras deve importar em outubro, contudo, representa menos da metade das importações totais do Brasil no mesmo mês do ano passado, de 1,6 bilhão de litros, segundo dados da reguladora ANP.
Ela adicionou que a refinaria da empresa no Paraná, a Repar, está parando para manutenção programada e retornará em novembro. Mas disse que as demais unidades de refino estão em operação, com fator de utilização "bastante alto".
DISTRIBUIÇÃO Em uma outra mesa da ROG.e, Pousada destacou que em março e abril deste ano a Vibra dobrou suas importações de diesel.
Segundo ele, a Vibra tem capacidade de importação nos principais portos brasileiros e acesso a diferentes fornecedores internacionais, o que permite à companhia reagir a mudanças nos fluxos globais de diesel.
Pousada ponderou que algumas fontes que tradicionalmente abasteciam o Brasil deixaram de fornecer o produto nos últimos meses, mas que a companhia conseguiu substituir esses volumes.
"Algumas fontes sumiram no mercado. Fontes que tipicamente abasteciam o Brasil pararam de abastecer e em nenhum momento faltou diesel para os nossos clientes", afirmou.
Questionado sobre um cenário de eventuais restrições ainda maiores à oferta internacional, Pousada disse acreditar que o principal impacto para o Brasil seria sobre os preços, e não sobre a disponibilidade do produto.
O aumento das importações no início do ano também expôs gargalos na infraestrutura brasileira, segundo Pousada. Ele afirmou que, ao dobrar as compras externas em março e abril, a Vibra conseguiu receber o produto pelos portos, mas enfrentou pressão sobre sua estrutura de transporte rodoviário para levar o combustível ao interior do país.
A empresa está mais acostumada a receber volumes por dutos diretamente da Petrobras ou de outras refinarias brasileiras, disse.
"Eu tenho capacidade no porto, pusemos um estresse em caminhões. Custo, isso é improdutividade do país", afirmou, defendendo mais investimentos em ferrovias e conexões entre portos e mercados consumidores.

items.title: Zelenskiy warns of painful winter for Russia if energy truce talks fail
items.author: Tom Balmforth, Antoni Slodkowski, Simon Lewis
items.creator: Tom Balmforth, Antoni Slodkowski, Simon Lewis
items.summary: President Volodymyr Zelenskiy warned Moscow at the United Nations on Wednesday that Ukraine would strike back and make the coming winter deeply painful for Russia, if the two sides cannot agree a truce on energy attacks before the cold sets in.
items.body:
President Volodymyr Zelenskiy warned Moscow at the United Nations on Wednesday that Ukraine would strike back and make the coming winter deeply painful for Russia, if the two sides cannot agree a truce on energy attacks before the cold sets in.
Ukraine and its allies are racing to secure limited agreements on energy infrastructure and Black Sea shipping before winter, fearing renewed Russian strikes on power and heating facilities, while Moscow continues to show little interest in wider negotiations to end the war.
"Ukrainians understand that this winter could be very harsh for us. But in response, we will have no choice but to make it painful for Russia too," Zelenskiy told the UN General Assembly during the annual gathering of world leaders in New York.
Though Russia has a far bigger arsenal of missiles which it has used to pound its enemy throughout the war, Ukraine has developed and used thousands of long-range drones to strike back at Russian warehouses, port infrastructure and oil refineries.
"That’s exactly why we say that de-escalation steps are needed before winter," Zelenskiy said, calling for more robust diplomacy and noting the potential sway that Chinese President Xi Jinping could have on Russian President Vladimir Putin.
China's Xi, who did not attend the United Nations gathering, was due on Thursday to hold White House talks with US President Donald Trump, with whom Zelenskiy met on Tuesday to discuss a ceasefire on energy-related targets.
NO SIGN OF CHANGING RUSSIAN POSITION Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov held talks with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Wednesday, after which Rubio said Ukraine and Russia had both voiced an interest in a limited ceasefire involving grain and energy-related targets.
There was no immediate sign of any movement in the Russian position, however.
A Russian Foreign Ministry statement said that at the meeting it had "reaffirmed its unconditional commitment to achieving the objectives of its special military operation," the phrase that Moscow uses to describe its war in Ukraine.
Addressing the 15-member Security Council on the sidelines of the annual UN gathering of world leaders, Lavrov indicated that Moscow would not countenance any temporary cessation of hostilities.
"Europe, whatever it thinks, just wants to get a pause, and it wants to use it to pump the Kyiv regime with weapons," he told a council session focused on the war in Ukraine.
Britain, France and Denmark's top diplomats used their speeches to deliver strong condemnations of Russia's war, warning variously of dangerous escalation and the spike in civilian deaths this summer.
'WE ARE WAITING FOR RUSSIA'S RESPONSE' Zelenskiy used his address to the General Assembly to single out Putin's role in driving the war, repeatedly describing him derisively as "patient zero" and "the one from whom this idea of war keeps spreading further".
"That is why 'patient zero' must be stopped. He must be denied the space to act – and the space to spread this evil further," he said.
Zelenskiy told leaders at a "Crimean Platform" summit on the sidelines of the UN that Kyiv was ready for a maritime truce in the Black Sea based on proposals such as those put forward by Egypt, India and Turkey.
"We are waiting for Russia's response. Ukraine is ready ... to ensure safe shipping and food security in the Black Sea if Russia is ready to take real steps towards de-escalation too. We have to start somewhere," he said.
Top wheat importers in Asia, the Middle East and Africa that count on the Black Sea region for wheat have been finding it hard to secure supplies. Global wheat prices have soared.

FAST

NEW YORK, Sept 23 : US shares fell and benchmark 10-year Treasury yields climbed to their highest level since 2007 on Wednesday, after data showed US business activity racing to a more-than-five-year high in September, fueled by a surge in new orders.
S&P Global said on Wednesday its flash US Composite PMI Output Index, which tracks the manufacturing and services sectors, increased to 58.4 this month, the highest level since July 2021.
"They're painting a picture of the economy not just being resilient, but overheating, and in that sense, robust economic growth is no longer balanced, it's adding to inflationary pressures,” said Will Compernolle, macro strategist at FHN Financial.
Yields have climbed to multi-year highs as traders price in the likelihood of further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, with inflation remaining stubbornly above the central bank's 2 per cent annual target.

Interest rate-sensitive 2-year Treasury yields rose 11.4 basis points to 4.891 per cent, after rising as high as 4.947 per cent, the highest since May 2024. The benchmark 10-year yield jumped 13.89 basis points to 5.106 per cent, the highest since 2007 and its biggest one-day increase since April 2025.
Fed funds futures traders are now pricing in a 66 per cent chance of an October rate hike, up from 53 per cent earlier in the day. 
Adding to the hawkish tone, Fed Governor Michael Barr said that the central bank took an important step last week to "recalibrate" short-term borrowing costs to bring down inflation, and signaled that further rate hikes will likely be needed.
A break through key technical levels amplified the rise in rates, analysts said.
"It looks like for now the technical boundaries that had kept a lid on yields for the last few weeks are just broken, and once this momentum starts it can make traders very hesitant to step in front of it,” Compernolle said.
The US Treasury Department also drew very weak demand for a $70 billion 5-year note auction amid the bond market selloff, with the notes selling at the highest yield at an auction since 2007.
Stocks slid as yields climbed. Higher rates can weigh on equities both by raising the cost of financing corporate investment and by luring buyers back into the bond market.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.68 per cent and the S&P 500 dropped 0.75 per cent. The Nasdaq Composite was down 1.13 per cent, a sharp reversal after hitting a record high on Tuesday.
The pan-European STOXX 600 index slid 0.44 per cent and an MSCI index of global stocks fell 0.73 per cent, snapping four consecutive days of gains.  
GEOPOLITICS IN FOCUS
Sentiment was further dampened by comments from Iranian leaders on Wednesday, underscoring that the US and Iran remain far apart on reaching a peace deal.
A senior Iranian official told Reuters that diplomacy must continue even as the two sides remain divided on how to end the war, after Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian told the UN General Assembly that Tehran would never bow to US pressure.
President Donald Trump, addressing the same forum on Tuesday, threatened to "annihilate" Iran but also said his envoys had held productive talks with mediators seeking to end the conflict.
"We've been through a series of starts and stops like this," said Cole Smead, CEO and portfolio manager at Smead Capital Management. "We're in a pretty momentum-dominated market. I don't think most people feel comfortable stepping in the way of headlines."
US crude rose 2.3 per cent to $92.60 a barrel and Brent rose to $103.50 per barrel, up 4.28 per cent on the day.
Investors are also looking ahead to a summit between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington, where tensions over trade, technology and Tehran are expected to play out against a backdrop of pomp and ceremony.
DOLLAR GAINS
The prospect of higher rates helped to boost the dollar to multi-week highs versus the euro, sterling and the Canadian dollar. The euro dropped 0.55 per cent to $1.1384 and had reached $1.1367, the lowest since July 28.
The dollar was 0.61 per cent firmer against the yen at 158.33, with speculators wary of drawing more Japanese intervention on any push past 160.00.
Spot gold fell 1.64 per cent to $4,283.40 an ounce.

items.summary: [北京 ２３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京 ２３日 ロイター] - 中国の習近平国家主席による今週の訪米に、中国企業の代表団が同行しない見通しであることが分かった。関係筋２人が明らかにした。理由は明らかになっていない。

関係筋の１人は、米政権には他の優先事項があると述べた。一方、別の関係筋によると、米当局者は中国軍と関係があるとみられる中国企業の代表が訪問に参加することを望んでいないという。

中国外務省報道官は定例記者会見で、中国企業代表団の同行に関する質問に対し、「その件に関する情報は持ち合わせていない」と述べた。

ロイターは先週、関係筋の話として、習氏の訪米に同行する中国の経済界トップの人選が進められており、米規制当局の厳しい審査や規制措置の対象となっている企業が、市場アクセス拡大を求めて代表団に加わる可能性があると報じていた。

items.title: Debilidad de precios de activos domina escena de mercados argentinos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La plaza financiera de Argentina finalizó el miércoles con prudencia y retracción sostenida de precios por la cautela entre los inversores ante factores locales y externos.
items.body:
La plaza financiera de Argentina finalizó el miércoles con prudencia y retracción sostenida de precios por la cautela entre los inversores ante factores locales y externos.
Las dudas de cara a las elecciones presidenciales del 2027 en Argentina y el prolongado conflicto en Oriente Medio que presionaba sobre el petróleo contribuían a la cautela en los negocios.
"El mercado argentino está en un punto de lateralización por la falta de un conductor sólido a mediano plazo ante la incertidumbre del año electoral, por lo que los activos permanecen tranquilos y las coberturas en dólares agilizan la dinámica", comentó un analista de riesgo de un banco español.
"Uno de los principales riesgos es que se tenga un nuevo cambio abrupto de timón político, por lo que la cautela domina la escena de los mercados. La dinámica de la economía real, con un necesario aumento en el ritmo del consumo, será vital para ver alguna nueva variable", agregó.
El presidente libertario argentino, Javier Milei, dijo que buscará su reelección, luego de ocupar el cargo en reemplazo de un Gobierno de centroizquierda desde diciembre del 2023.
El índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa porteña cayó un 0,94% a las 2000 GMT y los bonos públicos extrabursátiles retrocedieron un 1,2% promedio ante la salida de fondos institucionales, con un riesgo país que se ubicaba en los 557 puntos básicos, un nivel máximo desde inicio de mayo pasado.
Operadores coincidieron en que un aumento en la aversión al riesgo global jugaba en contra de los títulos públicos.
El peso mayorista apenas se depreció un 0,13% a 1.516,5 unidades por dólar , en un mercado donde el banco central (BCRA) suele intervenir diariamente para sumar reservas a sus arcas, en base a un acuerdo con el FMI.
La entidad monetaria argentina compró 6 millones de dólares de la plaza cambiaria.
"El mercado descuenta que habrá estabilidad total del tipo de cambio real hasta mediados del año que viene, según surge de la comparación entre las curvas CER (inflación) y 'dollar linked' (tipo de cambio)", reportó el agente de liquidación y compensación Facimex.
"Esto es mayormente consistente con lo que muestra la experiencia histórica de elecciones presidenciales con riesgo de reversión de políticas en Latinoamérica, aunque creemos que las valuaciones actuales dejan algo de espacio para captar valor rebalanceando posiciones a junio 2027", agregó.
El [USN:L1N45E0R2 TEXT:"Tesoro"] de Argentina concretó el martes un canje de deuda a corto plazo por equivalente a 3.332 millones de dólares, un 75% del volumen propuesto para despejar el horizonte financiero.
El Banco de Exportación e Importación de Estados Unidos tiene previsto financiar proyectos relacionados con minerales críticos y energía en Argentina por un valor de hasta 7.000 millones de dólares, según un documento al que tuvo acceso [USN:L6N45F08J TEXT:"Reuters"], como parte de una iniciativa para profundizar la cooperación económica entre Washington y Buenos Aires.

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: [ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は２３日、イランとの合意には一定期間にわたる多大な取り組みが必要になるとの見方を示した。また、トランプ大統領には軍事的な選択肢もあると記者団に語った。

ルビオ氏は、イラン問題について「われわれは（ホルムズ）海峡が問題であることを理解している」とした上で、「われわれは、引き続き海峡の防衛と開放を維持する」と述べた。

また、「イランとの合意が成立するなら、一定期間にわたる多大な取り組みが必要になるだろう」とした上で、トランプ大統領には軍事的選択肢を含め、多くの選択肢があると述べた。

items.title: First US-Iran talks in months raise hopes for progress despite no concessions
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner communicated through mediators on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.

First US-Iran talks in months raise hopes for progress despite no concessions

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner communicated through mediators on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and other delegates attend the 81st United Nations General Assembly at UN headquarters in New York City, US, on Sep 23, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Mike Segar)

UNITED NATIONS/DUBAI: The first shuttle talks between the United States and Iran in months raised hopes on Wednesday (Sep 23) that the adversaries could make progress towards ending the Middle East war, although neither side spelled out any change in its position.
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner communicated through mediators on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, the first such contacts since an interim ceasefire agreement collapsed in July.
"Steve and Jared had a very productive meeting today with mediators of Iran," US President Donald Trump said. "I think there's a lot of momentum for them to make a deal. It's what we're hearing from everybody."
Earlier, Trump had told the UN General Assembly in a speech that he had to decide whether to make a deal with Iran or " annihilate " it. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian was due to address the gathering on Wednesday.
Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei said Tehran had engaged with the United States through a Qatari mediator in New York and conveyed conditions, including an end to the war on all fronts and a halt to US "acts of aggression".
Some Iranian state media had earlier reported that Araghchi and Witkoff had met, but Iranian officials clarified to Reuters that it was not face-to-face. Araghchi met the prime minister of Qatar, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, one of the main mediators at previous talks.
The contacts offered the first diplomatic opening in months after negotiations broke down in July and fighting resumed across the region. Since then, the two sides have repeatedly exchanged fire , although Trump has stopped short of a full-scale resumption of US strikes after military commanders warned munitions stocks were running low.
IRAN HARDLINERS RESIST DIPLOMATIC MOVES The diplomatic contact in New York caused backlash in Iranian media associated with hardliners.
An opinion piece run by the semi-official Tasnim news agency, associated with the Revolutionary Guards, said Araghchi was wrong to have contacts with Witkoff and Kushner, "a major gift to Trump", as Iran had already conveyed its terms.
Iranian sources told Reuters the delegation had been ordered not to meet the Americans face-to-face by the Supreme National Security Council, a body that includes figures selected by Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, the supreme leader, who has yet to appear in public since replacing his father killed on the war's first day.
One Iranian journalist covering the visit told Reuters that some hardliners viewed the trip to New York itself as an insult to the memory of the slain leader, Ali Khamenei.

Related:

Iran 'toughened' conditions for ending war after US deal collapse: Guards spokesman

Iran attacks US targets despite Trump threats

OIL PRICES HOLD NEAR TWO-WEEK LOW Still, the diplomatic opening helped keep oil prices near two-week lows. Brent crude hovered around US$100 a barrel after surging earlier this month when Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis launched a major offensive, threatening traffic through the Red Sea, an alternative Saudi export route.
The war, launched by Trump in February alongside Israel as "Operation Epic Fury", has lasted nearly seven months, killing thousands of people, disrupting global energy supplies and spreading to other countries in the region - particularly to Lebanon and more recently to Yemen.
Trump repeated previous assertions that the war could end around the time of November's US midterm elections, though he has not explained why.
An interim agreement reached in June, signed by Trump and Pezeshkian, would have given Iran its main demands: lifting financial sanctions and unfreezing assets in return for talks on limiting its nuclear programme.
But that deal unravelled within weeks over shipping rules in the Strait of Hormuz, a conduit for a fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas before the war. Iran wants to exert control and collect fees from ships that use it, which Washington rejects.
In the latest reported attack in the strait, Britain's UKMTO maritime security agency said a cargo ship had been hit by projectiles, causing two casualties among the crew. The crew had been evacuated, and the ship was on fire and adrift.
Despite near-daily attacks, traffic through the strait has picked up in recent weeks. Oil producers pay shipping companies fees of as much as a quarter of a cargo's value to take the wartime risk of sailing through the strait with transponders switched off, before transferring crude to other vessels on the far side.
Exports from the United Arab Emirates have already recovered to pre-war levels, and Saudi Arabia has sold 60 million barrels of Gulf oil for both this month and next, to be delivered beyond the strait off the coast of Oman.
Nevertheless, a third of Gulf oil is estimated to be missing from global supplies. Shortages have particularly hit refined products such as diesel, causing inflation, pushing up interest rates and hurting Trump's Republicans ahead of the elections.

Source: Reuters/rk

items.title: Florida fund sues New York Times over alleged anti-Israel bias, demands records
items.author: Jonathan Stempel
items.creator: Jonathan Stempel
items.summary: Florida's state-run public pension fund and a conservative think tank sued the New York Times on Wednesday, seeking materials to determine whether the company's board is letting the newspaper promote biased editorial coverage against Israel.
items.body:
Florida's state-run public pension fund and a conservative think tank sued the New York Times (NYT.N) on Wednesday, seeking materials to determine whether the company's board is letting the newspaper promote biased editorial coverage against Israel.
According to a petition filed in a New York state court in Manhattan, a series of factual errors in Times reporting on various subjects supports a reasonable inference that the board has allowed journalistic standards to be "weaponized within the company to serve the personal agendas of unchecked editors."
The State Board of Administration of Florida (SBA), which oversees the Florida Retirement System Trust Fund, and the National Center for Public Policy Research said they are not second-guessing the newspaper's editorial judgment, but want assurances the board is making sure the Times follows its editorial standards and avoids "biased and unreliable" reporting.
Both petitioners are Times shareholders, and said New York state law entitled them to inspect its records but the newspaper refused.
"This lawsuit has no merit and was brought for an improper purpose," Times spokesperson Charlie Stadtlander said.
"Although it is positioned as a corporate governance petition to inspect the company’s books and records, it is a transparent attempt to exert agenda-driven pressure against an independent media organization, level false allegations of bias and chill journalism protected by the First Amendment," he added. "We will defend against the suit vigorously.”
BATTLES OVER ISRAEL COVERAGE, INDEPENDENCE Many media, including the Times, have faced accusations they have skewed coverage against Israel following the October 2023 outbreak of war in Gaza .
Wednesday's petition also escalates a growing battle nationwide over journalistic independence, including US President Donald Trump's decision last week to ban CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House. Those [USN:FWN45C04L TEXT:"outlets sued Trump"], saying the ban was unconstitutional and violated their First Amendment rights.
The Florida pension fund serves more than 1.2 million retirees, and had about $235.7 billion of assets under management as of August 31, according to its website.
Florida Governor Ron DeSantis and Attorney General James Uthmeier, both Republicans, are SBA trustees.
“The Times says unreliable journalism is a material risk," Uthmeier said in a post on X. "We asked if the board oversees its standards, and they refused to produce a single page."
WHISTLEBLOWER CLAIMS Wednesday's petition is based in part on claims by an unnamed former Times newsroom employee who worked there for a decade, and began complaining as early as 2019 about its alleged widespread culture of anti-Israel bias.
The petition said the Times repeatedly brushed off the whistleblower's complaints, including when a supervisor told her "it's not your job to be the ombudsman" and a human resources representative suggested she "go find a place whose values align with yours."
It also said the Times appears to have not followed through on Times publisher and board chair A.G. Sulzberger's commitment in 2019 to update its "unconscious bias training" to include a direct focus on antisemitism.
“We’re not trying to censor anyone," Steve Milloy, executive director of the think tank's Free Enterprise Project, said in an interview. "But if they want to go down as the paper of record, then there must be records backing up what they’re claiming.”

items.title: Iran's Pezeshkian accuses Trump of 'bullying mentality,' vows no surrender
items.author: Parisa Hafezi, Michelle Nichols
items.creator: Parisa Hafezi, Michelle Nichols
items.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian accused US President Donald Trump of a "bullying mentality" at the United Nations on Wednesday, saying Iran would not surrender in the war with the US but remained open to diplomacy to end the conflict.
items.body:
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian accused US President Donald Trump of a "bullying mentality" at the United Nations on Wednesday, saying Iran would not surrender in the war with the US but remained open to diplomacy to end the conflict.
In a wartime address to the 193-member UN General Assembly, Pezeshkian said threats would only harden Iran's resolve, rejecting Trump's warning that he could annihilate Iran if no deal were reached.
"The remarks made by the US president yesterday ... are a sign of a bullying mentality. ... The Iranian people will not bow to pressure. ... Those who are terrorists and train terrorists call us terrorists," he said, referring to Trump's description of Iran as the world's leading sponsor of terrorism.
Several times during his speech, Pezeshkian said Iran was ready to resolve tensions with the United States through negotiations, but warned that Tehran would not accept the language of force.
The United States delegation walked out at the start of Pezeshkian's speech. The US mission to the United Nations did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Pezeshkian began his address by accusing the United States of killing civilians during the war, holding up photos that included an image of schoolgirls in a classroom.
A missile strike on a primary school in Minab on February 28 – hours after US and Israeli attacks on Iran launched the conflict – killed more than 175 children and teachers, according to Iranian officials.
The Pentagon has not publicly released the findings of its investigation into the Minab strike, the deadliest civilian-casualty incident involving the US military in decades. Reuters reported on March 5 that an initial internal US military investigation found US forces were likely responsible for the strike.
Pezeshkian said Iran had no intention to seek nuclear bombs, but would not give up its right to a peaceful nuclear program.
"Neither nuclear weapons nor giving up nuclear knowledge," he said.
Seven months into a conflict that has rattled markets and pushed the Gulf to the brink of a wider war, Washington is unleashing an unprecedented economic offensive after military action failed to force Tehran to yield.
Iranian leaders fear a worsening economy , marked by surging prices, weaker trade and pressure on household incomes, could reignite nationwide unrest that has repeatedly challenged the Islamic Republic.
The Strait of Hormuz, conduit for a fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas, has become a focus of tensions between Iran and the US.
Tehran has conveyed its conditions to reopen the strategic waterway to the United States through mediators, Iranian sources told Reuters on Tuesday.
"It cannot be the case that everyone benefits from the Strait of Hormuz while we are denied access to shipping through this waterway. The permanent deployment of hostile fleets and the expansion of the war will not lead to peace," Pezeshkian said.

items.title: ＢｏｆＡ、英中銀利上げ予想に転換　半年で2回実施の見方
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２３日 ロイター] - バンク・オブ・アメリカ（ＢｏｆＡ）・グローバル・リサーチは、イングランド銀行（英中銀）が今後半年間で２回の利上げに踏み切るとの見方を示した。エネルギー価格の上昇でインフレが長期化するリスクが高まっていることを踏まえたもので、同様の予想を打ち出す他社に続いた。

同社は、英中銀が１１月と２月にそれぞれ０．２５％ポイントの利上げを実施すると予想。従来は金利据え置きが続いた後、２０２７年１１月に利下げに転じるとの見通しを示していたが、これを撤回した。

見通し変更の背景には、先週の英中銀会合で政策当局者が、特に足元の原油・天然ガス価格の急騰に起因するリスクについて、より強い調子で言及したことがある。これを受けバークレイズ、ＵＢＳグローバル・リサーチ、Ｊ．Ｐ．モルガンも利上げを予想している。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、市場は英中銀が１１月に利上げする確率を６７％織り込んでおり、１２月にもさらなる利上げが予想されている。

ただ、ＢｏｆＡは見通しを修正したものの、市場は引き締めを過大に織り込んでいる可能性があると指摘。英中銀が２０２８年に利下げを開始するまでに利上げは２回にとどまり、最終的に政策金利は３．５％に戻るとの見方を示した。

Sept 23 : Alphabet-owned YouTube unveiled a slate of artificial intelligence tools, shopping updates and personalized viewer features on Wednesday at its annual Made on YouTube event in New York City.
Here are some details:
• The new creator tools include additions to YouTube Studio for feedback on video drafts, channel-matched thumbnails and testing up to three video cuts.
• A Gemini-powered assistant in Shorts and YouTube Create will also help edit clips, trim pauses and sync music.

• The video platform is testing opt-in AI comment moderation that adapts to creators' preferences. It will also combine voice and facial detection in its likeness-protection tools.
• The company will expand its YouTube Shopping affiliate program to 35 countries by year-end, with more than 1.3 million creators already enrolled.
• Creators in India and Brazil will soon be able to tag Amazon products, while product tags will show localized offers to viewers in different markets.
• YouTube will introduce Custom Feeds for U.S. users on web, mobile and TV, allowing them to save homepage tabs tailored to interests such as documentaries or DIY videos.
• Its Ask YouTube feature will add shopping queries and follow-up questions, including product-comparison tables and voice commands for TV users.

items.title: アポロのプライベートクレジット、解約5%に再び制限－3四半期連続
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米オルタナティブ資産運用会社アポロ・グローバル・マネジメントは、プライベートクレジット・ファンドからの資金引き出しを3四半期連続で制限している。同社の投資家も、1兆8000億ドル（約285兆円）規模のダイレクトレンディング市場から資金を引き揚げる動きに加わっているもようだ。

約260億ドルの資産を運用するファンド「アポロ・デット・ソリューションズ」は22日、発行済み株式の14.7%相当の払い戻し請求を受け、償還を同5%に再び制限すると投資家に通知した。株主向け書簡で明らかにした。前期も16.8%の償還要求があった。

ブラックロックやクリフウォーターなど同業他社も、自社のプライベートクレジット・ファンドからの資金引き出しを引き続き制限している。融資の質や従来型ソフトウエア企業へのエクスポージャーを巡る懸念から、投資家が資金を引き揚げようとする中、今年は過去最大規模の解約の動きがプライベートクレジット市場を揺るがしている。

アポロ・デット・ソリューションズは7－9月期、総資金流入が約2億ドルだった。投資家が現金で受け取らず、新たな株式の購入に充てた配当金も含まれる。一方、株式の買い戻しに7億ドルを支払ったため、純流出額は約5億ドルと、純資産価値（NAV）の3%に上る見込みだ。同ファンドは、2022年の運用開始以来、年率8.2%のリターンを上げているとしている。

アポロによると、償還請求の大半は、以前の請求が全額満たされなかった投資家による再請求だった。書簡では、今年償還を求めた投資家は、今回の払い戻しにより、請求した資金の約75%を回収することになると説明した。

同ファンドは、未処理の買い戻し請求への対応を引き続き進めるとしたうえで、十分な流動性確保の手段を有しており、「必要に応じてレバレッジを若干高める」ことも可能だとしている。また、「より良好な市場環境の下で、運用会社が行った選択が、運用成績に表れ始めている」とも強調した。

items.title: バーＦＲＢ理事、追加利上げ必要との見方　「インフレ目標達成にリスク」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２３日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は２３日、ＦＲＢが先週の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げを決めたことについて、インフレ抑制に向けて金利を「再調整」する重要な一歩を踏み出したと評価した。その上で、さらなる利上げが必要になる公算が大きいと述べた。

バー理事はシカゴ連銀の住宅取得能力に関する会合で行う予定の講演原稿で「われわれのインフレ目標達成に対するリスクは高まった一方、労働市場のリスクは後退した」と指摘した。

さらに、米経済成長は力強く、労働市場は堅調だが、インフレはＦＲＢの目標である２％を上回る水準にとどまり、明確に低下する方向には向かっていないと述べた。「私のメインシナリオでは、インフレを適時に目標まで押し下げるため、追加の政策調整が必要になる公算が大きい」と語った。

バー理事は年内に少なくともあと２回の利上げが必要と考えている可能性がある。

バー理事は先週の利上げに言及し、「経済の変化を踏まえると、われわれは適切な位置になく、正しい方向に調整を行ったと思う。ＦＲＢは最大限の雇用を支える持続可能で息の長い成長を支援したいと考えており、物価の安定はそのために極めて重要だ」とした。

バー理事の金融政策に関する発言は短く、講演の大半は住宅取得能力問題に充てられた。住宅取得能力は供給不足と住宅ローン金利の高止まりで一段と悪化している。

items.title: 米企業、インフレ見通しを引き上げ　金利上昇を懸念＝ＦＲＢのＣＦＯ調査
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Howard Schneider

[ワシントン　２３日　ロイター] - 米国の企業財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は、今年と来年のインフレ率が一段と高まると予想しており、金利上昇を最大の懸念材料の一つに挙げ始めている。連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２３日公表した四半期調査から明らかになった。

財務幹部らは今年、価格を平均で５．３％引き上げる見通しを示した。第２・四半期時点の４．６％、年初時点の３．６％から上昇した。来年の価格引き上げ幅は平均４．５％と、第２・四半期時点の４．１％、年初の３．６％から上振れした。

最大の懸念事項としてインフレへの言及が少なくなった一方、「金融政策」に関する言及が最も多く、約２０％の企業が最大の懸念材料として挙げた。前回調査では１５％未満だった。
items.body:
Howard Schneider

[ワシントン　２３日　ロイター] - 米国の企業財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は、今年と来年のインフレ率が一段と高まると予想しており、金利上昇を最大の懸念材料の一つに挙げ始めている。連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２３日公表した四半期調査から明らかになった。

財務幹部らは今年、価格を平均で５．３％引き上げる見通しを示した。第２・四半期時点の４．６％、年初時点の３．６％から上昇した。来年の価格引き上げ幅は平均４．５％と、第２・四半期時点の４．１％、年初の３．６％から上振れした。

最大の懸念事項としてインフレへの言及が少なくなった一方、「金融政策」に関する言及が最も多く、約２０％の企業が最大の懸念材料として挙げた。前回調査では１５％未満だった。    

リッチモンド地区連銀のワデル副総裁は、財務幹部の景気全般に対する楽観的な見方は依然として強いものの、資金調達を巡る懸念が中小企業の見通しに影を落とし始めているとの見方を示唆。「課題がある場合、それは中小企業や資金繰りに制約のある企業で最も顕著だ」と述べた。

中小企業の約５分の１が、事業拡大計画の妨げになったり、コスト吸収を困難にしたりしていると回答した。企業全体では、今後６カ月間の設備投資は、半年前の見通しに比べ減少すると予想している。

設備投資を計画していない企業のうち、約４２％がその理由として「資金調達環境の悪化」や「現金確保の必要性」を挙げており、６カ月前の３２％から上昇した。   

 調査は８月１７日から９月４日にかけ、約５００社を対象にアトランタ地区連銀とリッチモンド地区連銀がデューク大学フクア経営大学院と共同で実施。これはＦＲＢによる先週の利上げ決定前、ＦＲＢの政策論議が利上げの可能性に傾き、投資家が借り入れコストの上昇に備え始めていた時期に当たる。

items.title: 米総合PMI、9月速報値は21年以来の高水準－新規受注や雇用が増加
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 9月の米企業活動は過去5年余りで最も速いペースで拡大した。堅調な需要を背景に、製造業とサービス業で新規受注や雇用が増加した。

雇用は4年余りで最も速いペースで増加した一方、投入価格の伸びは2022年以来の高水準となった。回答企業は主に燃料費や輸送費の上昇を要因に挙げ、多くの企業が賃金の伸び加速も指摘した。

S&Pグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスのチーフ・ビジネス・エコノミスト、クリス・ウィリアムソン氏は発表文で、「製造業、サービス業ともに企業活動は明らかに活況を呈している」と指摘。「ただ、こうした成長に伴い、新型コロナウイルスのパンデミック（世界的大流行）期を除けば約20年に及ぶ調査の歴史でも特に深刻な部類に入るサプライチェーンの目詰まりが生じている。企業からは適切な人材の確保が一段と難しくなっているとの報告も増えている」と述べた。

サービス業の企業活動指数は58.7へ上昇し、2021年以来の高水準となった。雇用指数は2022年6月以来の高水準だった。

製造業の指数は57に上昇し、2022年以来の高水準。需要の指標となる新規受注は2022年4月以来の速いペースで拡大し、雇用の伸びも2021年2月以来の高水準となった。

一方、サプライヤーの納期は2022年半ば以来最も長期化し、原材料コストも高止まりしており、サプライチェーンへの圧力が続いていることを示した。

今年の米企業活動は、堅調な個人消費やAIを背景とした企業投資、国防支出に支えられている。S&Pグローバルの最新データは、イランとの戦争に伴うエネルギーコストの上昇やサプライチェーンの混乱にもかかわらず、力強い需要が企業活動を支えている状況を示している。

ウィリアムソン氏は、パンデミック後の経済再開局面を除けば、9月の企業活動の改善は「2015年初め以降で最大だ」と述べた。

原題：US Business Activity Expands at the Fastest Pace Since 2021 (1)（抜粋）

items.title: Inflation pressures raise prospect of Fed rate hike on eve of elections
items.author: Ann Saphir, Howard Schneider
items.creator: Ann Saphir, Howard Schneider
items.summary: Mounting inflation pressures and a strengthening economy look to be pushing the Federal Reserve towards an interest-rate hike on the eve of critical national elections, with traders on Wednesday piling into bets on a second straight policy tightening in late October.
items.body:
Mounting inflation pressures and a strengthening economy look to be pushing the Federal Reserve towards an interest-rate hike on the eve of critical national elections, with traders on Wednesday piling into bets on a second straight policy tightening in late October.
A closely watched measure of US business activity, S&P Global's flash US Composite PMI Output Index, jumped this month to its highest level since July 2021, S&P Global reported on Wednesday. The survey's measure of prices paid by businesses for inputs surged to a nearly four-year high.
Oil prices took a leg up on Wednesday, with Brent crude futures rising about 2% to $101.09 a barrel, and diesel fuel is fetching over $6.50 a gallon on average, as the [USN:L1N45F09P TEXT:"US-Iran war"] continues to disrupt supply with little prospect for near-term resolution. Diesel has particular potential to broaden price pressures, as it powers the equipment and trucks used to make and move goods throughout the economy.
The backdrop of rising inflationary risks and a strong economy means the Fed is likely to deliver more rate hikes, Fed Governor Michael Barr said on Wednesday in what's become a rare bit of "forward guidance" from a US central banker.
"Risks to achieving our inflation target have increased, while risks to the labor market have receded," Barr told a Chicago Fed housing affordability conference. "In my base case, further policy adjustments are likely to be needed to ensure inflation comes down to target in a timely fashion."
In a unanimous decision last week, policymakers raised the central bank's key rate to the [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"3.75%-4.00% range"], and 16 of 18 of them signaled the Fed would probably need to deliver at least one more rate hike before the end of this year. Chairman Kevin Warsh said the Fed was removing "a dose of accommodation" but declined to say if he felt more would be needed.
Barr's remarks Wednesday suggest he feels at least two more rate hikes will be required, though he did not say by when.
"In my view, given changes to the economy, we were out of position, and we made an adjustment in the right direction," Barr said, referring to the quarter-percentage-point hike last week. "We want to support sustainable, durable growth in support of maximum employment, and price stability is crucial to that."
US Treasury yields jumped after Wednesday's data, with the benchmark 10-year yield rising back above 5% to its highest level since 2007. Unusually weak demand for 5-year Treasury notes at Wednesday's auction also helped send 5-year note yields to their own 19-year high.
Short-term US interest-rate futures contracts were pricing about a 70% chance of another rate hike at the October 27-28 meeting, up from about 55% earlier in the day.
Days after that October Fed decision, President Donald Trump's Republicans will be defending slim majorities in both houses of Congress in national elections set for November 3.
Back-to-back rate hikes could underscore the affordability concerns that polls show are a top issue for voters and are undercutting Trump's popularity. Analysts say the inflation the Fed is addressing stems in large part from the administration's policy decisions, including sharply higher tariffs and the war in Iran.
Affordability concerns for would-be homeowners are also in focus. The Mortgage Bankers Association reported Wednesday that the average rate on a US 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rose to a more than two-year high of [USN:L6N45E14E TEXT:"7.12%"] last week.
Trump has laid into the Fed -- though not Warsh personally -- for what he calls a "political" decision to raise, [USN:L6N45915R TEXT:"not cut"], rates. He has sought to address inflation concerns with proposals including ending the war in Iran after the elections, and banning exports of US diesel.
In an interview released Wednesday, Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said the central bank may need to treat the current energy shock as a source of persistent inflation rather than expect it to dissipate on its own, an approach that implies he also feels more rate hikes could be needed.
"For big negative supply shocks ... you'd be better off just assuming from the beginning that this thing is going to be pretty persistent on inflation: that's certainly what happened in Covid; that's what happened with the tariffs. That's maybe what's happening with oil," Goolsbee said in a "Economics, Applied" podcast. "So we better be careful."

items.title: 原油反発、ブレントは100ドル台－ディーゼル燃料の急騰が影響
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ニューヨーク原油相場は反発。中東からの原油輸送が回復するとの見方が広がる一方で、トレーダーは燃料価格の急騰を意識している。

国際指標の北海ブレント原油先物は1バレル当たり100ドル台を回復した。前日までは5営業日続落していた。トランプ米大統領が前日、ディーゼル燃料の輸出禁止案に前向きな姿勢を示したため、この日は欧州のディーゼル先物が急騰した。これが原油価格の上昇に弾みを付けていると、サクソバンクの商品戦略責任者、オーレ・ハンセン氏は指摘した。

ディーゼル市場では中東とロシアからの供給が急減し、米国が主要な供給国となっている。原油市場では米国からの輸出が停止される懸念が、サウジアラビアの原油輸出が回復するとの楽観を相殺した。

サウジは26日までに東西パイプラインの再稼働を目指すとしている。同国はペルシャ湾岸からの輸出についても、高いペースを維持しているもようだ。

それでもホルムズ海峡を巡るリスクは続いている。英国海運貿易オペレーション（UKMTO）によれば、同海峡を航行中に飛翔体の攻撃を受けた貨物船で火災が発生し、漂流している。

トランプ米大統領は前日、米・イラン代表が3時間にわたって協議したと明らかにし、「非常にうまくいった」と成果を強調したが、市場の反応は冷ややかだったと、サクソバンクのハンセン氏は指摘した。「解決につながる具体的な行動が双方から求められている」と同氏は述べた。

キャピタル・エコノミクスのエコノミスト、ハマド・フセイン氏によれば、ディーゼル燃料の輸出が禁止されれば、米国内のディーゼル価格はいったんは下落する可能性があるものの、国内で石油を輸送する能力に制約があるため、いずれ在庫が積み上がり、製油業者は生産削減を余儀なくされる。

ニューヨーク時間午前10時現在、北海ブレント11月限は前日比2.2%高の101.41ドル。ウェスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（WTI）11月限は同2.7%高い91.97ドル。
